I'm not sure where I first saw this item (Game Time Men's MLB team Schedule Series watch, in my case Washington Nationals) but it looked like a really neat gadget and nearly instantly appealed to me because, well, it's a gadget and because it relates to my being a baseball fan.

I'm sure that I could find some means of getting a schedule for my favorite team or perhaps all of the teams in MLB into one of the portable devices that I carry around, be it my 'Smartphone' or my iPod Touch, but then again I don't always carry my iPod Touch and I'm too frugal to pay for a data plan to use with my Smartphone (I have a Smartphone so I can sync my contacts and schedules with my PC, but I don't carry a data plan as I don't want to shell out that much money for what really seems to be a limited network usage experience).

When I'm home I can easily check the team schedule online, or I could just check in the "old school" printed newspaper and find the daily match-up information if I want to, but then I tend to simply glance at the information when I do see it and not remember it later in the day as game time rolls around.  (Some may ask why not surf for such information while at work and the answer to that question is that while it's ok to check news sites and such, the internet at work is really supposed to be used for work and not for amusement...)

Anyway, as I mentioned above, I grew intrigued with this device from pretty much the moment I first saw ads for them online.  I wear a watch nearly all of the time and having the schedule information where I can look at it quickly and easily (at a glance) is really nice.  Add in the melody feature that plays the "Take me out to the ballgame" tune when the game is starting and you have a pretty nifty little gadget.

I mention in the review title that a few things keep this item from perfection.  What are those things?  One would be that there are parts of the information on the display that are hard to read/see.  The LCD font is good, but not perfect, and some parts of some letters on the display are a bit thin and not as clear as one might wish for.  The team logo takes up a healthy portion of the display space and is merely stenciled and/or painted onto a small covering over the bottom third (give or take) of the display.  If that logo were perhaps a bit smaller, then there might be more room to enlarge the fonts on the screen a little.  That said, well, part of the appeal of this watch is having the logo for your own favorite team displayed for others to see your team spirit, so I don't expect future versions will be all that different.

One of the other things holding back perfection is the cost for future schedule downloads and the worry that such updates might not be available for some reason or another (if the leagues decide to stop doing business with the makers of the device as an example).  The device ships with a special USB cable and adapter that connects the device to a PC (sorry Mac users, the device's instructions don't mention Mac at all, and simply state the operating systems supported as "Windows ME, Windows 2000, and Windows XP".  That said, it appears that Windows Vista wouldn't be a problem at all...) and users are instructed to visit the manufacturer's website at [...]  Once you connect to that website you'll find that the manufacturer charges a nominal fee ($9.95 at the time this review is written) for schedule updates.  The process appears to be fairly straight forward and simple enough and is documented nicely in the simple and clear instructions that come with the device.

I mention that the instructions are simple and clear and they are just that, though I note at least one part of the instructions that was wrong -- the procedure that tells how to turn off the melody shows the wrong button.  It was easy enough to experiment and find the proper button, but it could be frustrating trying to follow the instructions only to find that you just can't turn off the melody (which seems to be defaulted to being 'on' when you purchase the device).

On the plus side the battery for the device is user replacable in what seems to be a very easy process.  The back of the device offers a cover that can easily be opened by using the edge of a penny or similar coin.  Turn the battery cover clockwise and it should pop off easily enough and allow quick access to replacing the CR2032 battery.

Possibly related to that plus is another slight negative, the device is NOT really water resistant.  The instructions note Water/splash resistant only -- do not submerge.  It would be nice to be more assured that the device would be more water resistant so owners/users wouldn't need to worry about keeping it from getting soaked, but I expect that the device would be just fine if you don't try to swim with it on.

That about covers things for this review.  If you're looking for a buy it or not recommendation, I'd say this is easily something that is worth spending your money on, even if the price seems a little high compared to budget priced watches that can be found so easily.  The Game Time Men's MLB Schedule Series watch seems to be constructed to be relatively durable, with a bezel that helps protect the LCD display and should help prevent scratching and other damage.
summary: Only a few things keeping it from perfection

reviewText: Purchased product in Nov 2011 for Xmas and when it was time to wrap it, I discovered that the battery was dead. (4 stars, because the watch is overpriced and the hidden update fee)
Frankly I am a little pi$$ed.
I bought this watch from Amazon (I double checked the invoice and they were the seller not just a middle man)
My wife is a HUGE Philles fan and I bought this for her birthday
When I got it I opened it to ensure that it was up to date and that the timezone was set
Timezone was wrong, even though the documentation says the timezone is set for the team time zone
I am in Harrisburg PA in the same time zone as Philly - but if I complain about that I am just being petty because I am mad :(

Anyway, opened the packaging and read through the instructions
It says it plays "Take me out to the ball game" before a game starts so I checked the time zone (fixed) and also corrected the time
It was about half an hour until the game started so I just waited
To my surprise at the time the game should have started there was no chime or song, nothing
I read through the manual and it says you have to enable "Melody" to get the song, it even has a musical note indicator to let you know that mode is active
To do this you hit the "select" button 3 times
That brings up the correct screen but the next step in the instructions is to hit the "Select" button again to enable melody, however hitting select again at that point takes you back out to the main watch face and out of the sound select mode :(  grrrrr very frustrating

I don't know anything about baseball so I go out the the Phillies web site and look at the schedule to make sure the thing is correct
Low and behold the wrong game is on the watch
I am guessing I have the schedule from a year ago but am not sure how to figure that out
I guess I would have to find last year's schedule online and compare, but I really don't have the time to do that right now

Really frustrated by now, I figured MAYBE it "knows" its out of date so the melody won't play until it is on the proper year (Yeah a bit of a stretch but my wife's birthday is in 2 days and I am desperate)
So I go out to the website and go through their store front and find where you can download the schedule
THEY WANT 10$!!!!
True, its not alot of money, but I just paid 99$ for this freaking DIGITAL watch and now they want 10 bucks a year from me until my wife is too old to care about baseball!?!?!?!
Come on!  It's a freeking txt file, see if I don't hack your darn download and edit it to put in next year's schedule manually.  Capitalistic jerks.
Enraged I look through my documentation and find a coupon for a free download.
I'm still NOT happy, the product description clearly states that it comes programed with the current season, it does not say it comes with an old one and a free update coupon.
I should have a free year (the one on it when you get the watch new) and be able to use the coupon for the NEXT year.
I growl at myself for waiting so long to buy the gift and painting myself into a corner and enter the coupon code to get the stupid watch updated.
SOB!  IT WON"T TAKE MY CODE!!!

<sigh tiredly at the end of a bad friday>

In all fairness I bet I am just the victim of a comedy of errors
I bet others get the watch, with the correct year on it, and the chime works and their wives love them forever for it.
I looked on the Amazon site to see if I could find a customer service number but could not find any
Its 7 pm my time so everyone's business offices are closed
Since the schedule file is just a downloadable file, and I might be able to do this Monday I will try to contact all parties invited to see if I can resolve this before her party
I will update this review with what happens

Ideally Amazon will just give me the code I need to download the current season, that might be enough for me to call this even.
If not and they offer me 10$ credit on my account I will still say they acted in good faith
I really won't be happy if they tell me to "smoke a fat one and get lost"
I will let you all know

In closing, hardware wise the watch seems sound, and if your a BIG fan like my wife you will probably love this darn thing to death, just be warned about the 10$ a year fee, as I was not

<<<EDIT 6/6/2011>>>
Called Amazon and they couldn't help me at all.  They said I could return the watch for a refund but coulden't give me the 10$ credit or the proper code.  I spoke with a  phone rep named Marge.  She did offer me the manufacturer's phone number though.  I called it and it was a wrong number :(

I went online and found the proper number for technical support for these phones to be 888-249-9627 (opt 2)
Called and was told that I had the wrong website.  So, if you buy this watch ignore the website on the coupon (don't go to gametimeshop.com for the update)
The website which WILL work with your code is schedulewatch.com (and if your code is like mine, then its a zero not the letter O)
Went there, used the code from the coupon and was able to get the update!  :)
Ran the update and the schedule was then correct

One last problem.... the instructions which were included with my watch are wrong
To hear the "take me out the ball game" when a scheduled game starts you have to enable the "melody" option
My copy of the instructions say you need to hit the "select" button 3 times to get to the "alarm viewing" screen
Then you have to hit "select" again HOWEVER this just takes you to the next screen
What you REALLY need to do is hit the "forward" button
When you do that the music note shows up letting you know that Melody is enabled.

Still 4 stars, because they make you pay for a schedule which is freely available on the internet
summary: I don't see anywhere in the write up where they tell you it cost 10$ to update?!?

reviewText: Yes, they're cute for sure, but how could these possibly fit a 12 month old?  Maybe with the pattern half way down his foot it still fits, but certainly doesn't look like a shoe at that point.  He pretty much grew out of them by ~6-7 months and he's not especially big (less than 50% in both height and weight).  I also don't think they stay up that great, as much as I was hoping to find the perfect fitting sock.  We have other socks that stay on him better (hand-me-down Nike's actually), but we also have MANY more that perform worse, so I would say these are above average regarding staying on his feet.  (He's doesn't have super chubby ankles or calves, so again not sure why they don't stay on that well.)  But each baby is shaped so different that they may work great for others.  Overall I think they're cute enough to still justify the purchase, but I wouldn't rate them as the best socks ever (which is what I was hoping for after reading so many other reviews.)  Oh well, the search continues...

reviewText: I love this watch!!!  The build quality and precision you come to expect in a Swiss watch is all here.  The bezel is all stainless and the glass face is clear and big (not too big though, like those "other" outdoor watches).  It's a heavy watch and it's ready to do battle in the outdoors.  The band is exceptionally nice with matching red stitching, a stainless buckle, and sturdy, bendy water proof silicon construction.  The compass portion of the watch is dead on when properly calibrated (easy to do).  The instructions are easy to follow and guide you through all the settings for the watch.  As nice as this watch is, two things to keep in mind for the future would be: battery replacement and band replacement.  The battery is not user serviceable and will need to be replaced by a shop that has the special tool to remove the back (typical with all fine watches).  The band itself, if ever needing replacement, looks expensive and may be difficult to obtain (probably only through Wenger). But overall, if you are looking at this watch because you want a digital compass watch (the reason I bought it)  with a little more sophistication, metal construction and Swiss reliability, than this is the only watch of it's kind out there for the price.  A great value!

I started looking at TAG HEUER Formula 1 for their rugged good looks with white on black numbers in a larger case. But they were very expensive and very heavy. I ran across the Wenger with very similar looks, Swiss Army Knife quality like a Heuer, and a fraction of the price. More than a Timex, for sure, but lots less hulk than a Heuer (43 mm vs. 44mm) and weight, not to mention the attractive price. The silicone strap works perfect and still looks like leather. My only complaint is with the LED date that I simply cannot get set to operate correctly,(who cares, I'm retired), and the impossibly complex compass (why start now knowing what direction I'm going.) The ability to see the digital LED time in a dark theatre is all I really need.  TAM

Four stars because the watch is quite thick but not too thick and the band is silicone, I will be replacing with a nylon band.  Over all great buy and very good quality like aways from Wenger.

Pros:
-It is heavy, durable, and has a quality feel to it. It's a Wenger of course
-The compass feature is awesome and it works fairly accurately.
-Easy to follow instructions for setting time and compass
-Accuracy is excellent

Cons:
-Very weak illumination on the numbers even when charged by external light sources.
-No illumination on the hands at all, then why would you illuminate the numbers?
-No way to tell time in the dark aside from pressing the digital time.
-Watchband has a strong rubber smell. It might be annoying to some
-Price

For less money you can purchase a number of Casio, Seiko, and Citizen watches that will provide you with better reliability and features that are not available on this watch. I really liked this watch, but the absense of the illumination was a deal breaker for me.

This one has intrigued me for a while. I have not been disappointed. Very good looking and serious watch. The LED displays pop out in the dark as visibly as could be wished.

I note others have had complaints with the strap. I replaced my strap with a 22m/m nylon NATO type immediately upon receipt, so I have nothing useful to add there.

I opted for the free shipping, and it stated that this shipping is not fast-and it wasn't. Can't complain, it was clearly so stated, but be advised if you need one in a hurry that a shipping upgrade is very much in order.

The compass has proven MUCH easier to calibrate than my Marathon Navigator II digital. It only took a couple of minutes, and the procedure was so simple you kept looking for what you'd overlooked in the procedure-turns out you hadn't neglected anything.

Quite a nice wristwatch, especially for someone who works in the early hours.

The Wenger Nomad is the most stealthy ana/digi watch I own or have seen. Except for the four pushers, 2 on each side, you would never guess it has digital capabilities. The sun ray black face is beautiful, with stylish, easy to read hands. A push and any button reveals a large easy to read, red digital display, with all expected functions, time, day, and date. The surprise function is a digital compass that not only works well, you can enter declination for your location so it is accurate too. The only short coming of this watch is the rubber band. If you have a wrist larger than 7.5 inches you will need to purchase a larger band. I would not let that stop me, though, this is a very unique and sporty compass watch. Of course it is Swiss made, and the quality shows.

When I was a kid, we made do with whatever we had for the occasional and rare snowfall. Usually this meant some very cold feet and hands before too long. I've since learned that good clothing denigrates bad weather.

We generally rely on hand-me-downs for our kids and then pass on these gifts to others. They outgrow them so quickly that it hardly makes sense to spend even $20 for something they'll wear only one season. But I couldn't find snow boots for my 5yo Smiling Son. The new ones I found at Target and Walmart were all branded with pop culture characters and overly priced for the quality. Not only do we try to stay away from branded clothing, but they just weren't what we were looking for.

Looking at the reviews of one brand here at Amazon, I was ready to click the "Buy" button - even though they were a bit spendy, when I read a review talking about the high quality of the boots - and how that was unnecessary because the kids outgrow them so fast.

That's when I found these virtually no-name books with an inner liner, front zipper, sturdy, and unbranded.

My son loves them. The front zipper makes them easy for him to put them on himself. The inner liner comes out for easy drying. The color is great for a boy - but could easily be passed onto a kid of any gender next year.  And best of all, they keep his feet warm and dry.

reviewText:
Not 90/10, but 65/35.
I had initially purchased 2 directly from Hane's, Charcoal Heather and Deep Royal.  DD's friend kidnapped her Charcoal Heather, so I looked at the Deep Royal's label and saw it was 90/10, so I figured I'd simply order from Amazon.  When I received this package today, I went straight to the label and it says 65/35.  Well, strangely enough, the original Charcoal Heather was also 65/35 (as per the kidnapper), which Hane's had sent, so I decided to keep this Amazon 65/35, since it matched the original exactly to DD's liking.

BUT in reality, it isn't labelled/sold to the specifications, which might upset cotton lovers, like myself.

EDIT:
From the Hane's website, in the comments section, I found 2 replies that had this information, which seems quite valuable, which Hane's themselves do not provide in the item description:
"  FABRIC: 90% CTN/10% POLY 10 OZ. EXCEPT FOR LIGHT STEEL WHICH IS 85% CTN/15% POLY, & CHARCOAL HEATHER WHICH IS 65% CTN/35% POLY. OXFORD GREY:65CTN/35POLY ".
Both Hane's and Amazon should really provide this information...

reviewText:
I was so excited to take advantage of the recent $39.20 deal Amazon ran on the Peggy boot.  I have used Propet brand boots before... they were the only ones I could find at the time that I could afford, and in wide sizes.

Where to start?  These boots did not have grommets through which to thread shoelaces, which made it difficult to relace the boots from the factory pre-set.  They only had holes punched through the leather, and not all of the holes were wide enough, so I had to force the shoelaces through the holes... struggling with some.  The shoelaces themselves were cheap, and started to fray as I was relacing the boots.

One of the reasons I wanted this boot was that it was supposed to fit my custom orthotic.  Unfortunately, once I had the provided insoles removed, and mine inside, the boots were too tight.  Not only were they too tight, something in the heel dug into my heel.  I wear a 9.5 2E.

Lastly, the stretchable vamp puffed up and looked odd.

Anyone who suffers from neuropathy in the feet knows that it is truly a feat (pun intended) finding shoes that you can comfortably wear. I normally wear ASICS because I have purchased many pairs of shoes only to give them away because my feet would begin tingling after just an hour of wear.  These shoes are PERFECT for my problem feet.  Did not have to break them in and the removable insoles allow me to wear thin or thick hosiery. The ankle support is excellent as well and, the flexibility on the top of the shoe allows for movement of my toes without pinching.

I purchased the Bronco Brown but I am going to get the black as well.  I would highly recommend these shoes to anyone but, especially to those who have problem feet. Now I'll be a happy walker!

I wear 8.5 2e an this boot fits nice with orthoics an leaving all the liners in. Love love the stretch leather in front no pressure on your forefeet at all. Soft leather, needed heavy regular sock.  Lots of support. I have bought thousands of $$$ of shoes an they don't fit my orthoics with this stretch leather it works.  Best my feet have felt in years
even though i live in florida i hate to wear socks an boots but my orthoics are very wide an this feels great. Ordering black today......:)
I love the way this boot feels.  The fit is adjustable with 2 separate insoles and the stretchy toe area is really neat.

I was really surprised to find a boot that had a mesh top.  In my part of the country boots are used to walk in places that a shoe isn't  as protective.  The mesh on top of the toe and up to the mid foot feels strange.  The neck of the boot, that fits above the ankle is very stiff and uncomfortable.  As I procrastinated over the holidays, I will have to find a shoe repair service who may be able to soften up the neck of the shoe.  They are very uncomfortable to even sit in. However, they seem really well built.  Someone with very tough skin may be able to wear them without adjustment.

I've ordered other Propets that were really off size in the past.  But these boots are more true to size.  I Like the expanding front for heavier sox in colder weather or extra supports.  They also do have 2 foot bed inserts that each come out.

These are a lot cuter in the picture than in person. They are a bit masculine looking and run a bit narrow. I should have ordered a 4E. The leather looks cheap as well. I primarily wear Propet, as they have great support and difficult to find sizes. Generally, their leather is soft and comfortable, but these feel like synthetic material and aren't' as comfortable as their other boots.
The shoe was too small and not attractive at all. I would not recommend purchasing this shoe, you will be disappointed.

I have heel spurs but these fit great!  Very comfortable & takes different insole types which helps me with spur problems. The only problem I had was that they squeaked.  I found a solution, saddle soap the tongue & lace area. Now I have the perfect boot! I love them so much that I also bought the brown color. This is the best price I found anywhere.

Propet brands are reliable, they are true to size, excellent support and good padding in the foot bed. These boots look good with jeans and work trousers, the sole is comfortable and they are flexible when walking.

These boots run very narrow.  I have wide feet and I normally wear a c/d width.  I ordered my size in the c/d width and they were way too narrow.  Otherwise they seem nice but provide very little arch support.
These are super comfortable and good ankle support.  This is the third pair we have bought.  Hope they don't ever discontinue them.

Upon unpacking these shoes I was very disappointed that my prosthetic didn't fit into the right shoe, nor did the left foot that is whole fit either.  I called the number shipped with the shoes, they sent  the company an email to get in touch with me ASAP the girl said they would contact me by email they never did, I contacted Amazon they said I had to contact the company.  Being new customer of Amazon I did not know what to do . . . finally new info showed up on the web site and I could a easily return items . . .I tried it was too late.  My toes were amputated and had no way or anyone to help us get to the post office,  At this point in time I am stuck with $75.00 shoes I can't wear and can't return and here is what we were sent; Elite Hero has closed the return request listed below.

Reason for the closure of your request: Expiration of returns period

WHAT WOULD BE EASY IS IF THE RETURN LABEL CAME WITH THE PRODUCT SOME PEOPLE DON'T HAVE PRINTERS!
A BIT SHADY IF YOU ASK ME.

I think for anyone who is new to the site shouldn't be so trusting  I will never buy another pair of shoes from this company or Amazon sad that when people aren't able to get to post office or get any help returning items.  I am out $75.00 that could be used towards shoes that do fit.  Lesson here is DO NOT TRY AND save money.  Buy what the prosthetic people suggest even if it is money out of your own pocket and $1000's of dollars.
summary: Returns are easy NOT when you are new to amazon site!

After wearing baseball caps for years, I've recently transitioned to wearing Kangol caps. I like the look and they certainly have a more "grown up" feel to them. But they also have exceptional build quality and fit very nicely.

The Kangol 504 is their best known design and essentially the one all their newer cap models are based on. The "Ventair" means it's a lighter, much more breathable 504, perfect for summer or any hot weather.

My only complaint is that the colors shown on Amazon don't quite translate to the real product. I bought the Tan model but found it wasn't quite as brown as the pictures show. Not an issue for me, but something to keep in mind.

Also note if you're used to wearing other caps, say, New Era, that Kangol sizes aren't quite the same. For reference, I wear New Era 7 3/8, which is said to be the equivalent to a Kangol large, but I've found that medium fits my head better. So you may want to order a couple different sizes and then return the one that doesn't fit.

I am now ordering another of these hats because I lost my first one. These are fantastic hats BUT: you have to understand how to use them! Yes, the hat is unusually long, as many reviewers have commented.  It would fit a Conehead perfectly, if you understand the reference.  Yes, if you wear it normally the top will stick up like a witch's peaked hat and you will look like an idiot. So what do us normal-sized head people do?  We fold up the bottom layer as far as necessary to allow the top of the hat to cover the top of your head without slack. In my case this results in about 4 inches of doubled up hat at the bottom, which results in DOUBLE THICKNESS OVER YOUR EARS!  What could be more perfect? It's your ears that feel the cold the most!  Also note that the illustration shows the hat folded at the bottom exactly the way it should be on your head, with a double layer at the bottom. I believe this is the theory behind the hat being so tall, and for me, it works great and it's the warmest woolen cap I've ever had, and seems to be top quality and very durable too.
summary: The best woolen hat you can buy, but only if you know how to use it

reviewText:
Hat is as expected as far as quality. I don't see any defects in the hat whatsoever.
Concerns are around the tightness of the weave. When you look at a light source (day light, lamp, etc) through the material, light clearly shines through, and this is where cold wind will go through as well. I was hoping that there is much tighter weave so that cold wind will not go through. Some reviewers also mentioned that it is very thick...this is not the case. It has the same thickness per layer as cheap acrylic hats from a dollar store. It's a question of what to expect for the price, versus a top notch wool hat. I would have liked a tighter thicker hat that can block wind better.
I have a very large head and it fit my head perfectly so I don't think that this is going to be a problem for any user. Another user posted a picture of the hat being 30 cm  / 12 Inches, however it is folded over  in normal wear, so it's more than fine (and if you don't want to fold it over you can also do part time wizard duty with it :))
Overall an OK hat, but I would have been willing to pay more for a higher quality hat that can block the wind, or is a combination of a breathable membrane and wool. As long as you understand what you are getting it's an ok hat, but it will not be close to the warmth of a shearling hat, or a hood of a good parka. The whole idea for me was to use this hat instead of a the hood of a parka where the the latter obstructs your peripheral vision, making crossing busy streets treacherous in high traffic areas.
summary: OK hat, not worth more than $9 and not a good wind blocker (loose weave that you can see light through)

This is a simple 100% wool navy watch cap (ski hat). It is navy blue in color. I have a larger than average adult male head and it fit just fine as far as circumference goes.  When laid flat and not rolled upward, it is exactly 12 inches (31 centimeters) tall from the top of the hat to the bottom of the seam. As the photo of the item shows, you generally wear the hat with the bottom rolled upward toward the top of the hat. This hat, at 12 inches, gives a lot of hat to roll up.  If you want the top of the hat to sit right on top of your hed with no space in between, you may roll about 1/2 of the hat back up the side of your head. So this is not a "small" hat. I have other navy watch caps with much smaller amount of material to roll up when you wear it. The wool is soft and it does not scratch your head. There is a very small tag (maybe one inch by 1/2 inch) on the inside top of the hat that looks like it would be difficult to remove, but it does not annoy too much since it is so small. Overall, this hat is just fine if you don't mind the large length.

But still, I have to double fold the brim to get a ratio of hat top to brim as pictured.  It does have a decent shape.  Just a little long.  Warm.
summary: Have to double fold the brim.  But its a good hat

reviewText: This is definitely a plain black wool hat.  Its performance is comparable to other black wool hats.  But twelve dollars seems expensive, because there really aren't any bells or whistles on this thing.
summary: It is DEFINITELY a Wool Hat

reviewText: This hat is just a little bit tight, but honestly I don't really mind that. It's extremely warm (especially under a hood, or anything to keep the wind off). For $12, you can't beat it.
In fact, i'm wearing it now.x x x x x x x x x x x x x x x
Perfect for me. A trifle snug but that's what you want from a woolen cap that is worn for warmth, right?

A very generous amount of knitting allows this snug fitting VERY warm wool cap to be pulled down to cover the ears entirely and most of the back of the neck., with plenty left over to still be folded.  Very well made, thick wool that the wind will not penetrate.
summary: If you can't fit your head in this....

reviewText: I love wool watch caps.  This one is great.  Highly recommended.  My head has been warm as our temperature stayed at 0 for a few weeks.

This hat is simple, warm, durable. I've been a fan of wigwam socks for years and the hat didn't disappoint either. I lose hats all the time so i just went ahead and ordered two because of the price. I could see that it might be tight on someone with a large head, but wool should stretch over time.
It's very suitable for my husband, so warm, so beautiful. I love it. ee eee eee eee ee ee ee

Overall I love this cap!

It keeps my head and ears very warm during cold mornings at work.

I have to say every 20 minutes or so, I find my self lifting up the cap and scratching my forehead.
Maybe I'm allergic to wool? Or just sensitive to wool. I don't know.

I don't usually buy clothing made of wool, so I guess that is very possible.

There are absolutely no visible irritations on my forehead, it's just that it itches whenever I wear this cap.

Like I said, overall I love this cap and I think it is a great value.
I would recommend it. I'm just saying you may want to be aware if you know your skin is sensitive to wool.

Maybe I just need to get used to it.

Four stars for sure.

Update: Six weeks later

After wearing this cap consistently for the last month and a half, the itching has stopped.
I'm not sure what it was, maybe my head had to get used to wool.
But I love this cap and it keeps my noggin / ears very warm on those cold mornings at work.
I am now giving this product a five star rating.
It is worth every penny.

I waited until we had some single digit weather before I wrote a review.  I can confirm that this hat is much warmer than the common polyester/acrylic hats that are sold everywhere, however, I still wish it had a tighter weave to stop more of the wind.

I received this hat today and I wore it this evening while walking my dog.  It was -31C outside with almost no wind and this hat was WARM.  I was outside for 45 minutes and I'm talking no need for a hood warm!  As other reviewers have noted, it initially fits snug but quickly molded to my head.

I have 3 points to make about this hat:

1. This hat is made from thick wool and it is heavy.  I am very happy with the quality.
2. It is extremely warm
3. It is made in the USA!

Needed something to keep my ears warm on a trip I knew would reach -10... With wind chill -20. I used for 5-10 minutes out at a time. Did a very good job at keeping ears and head warm. Good price/value/quality for what I needed.
By far the warmest hat I have ever worn,  It is comfortable and stays put on your head.  I love it and will refer my friends to this product.  Way to go Amazon!
summary: This is the warmest hat I have ever owned.  I am impressed with the quality and superior warmth this beanie provided.

reviewText: Let's see,,,,,, I have worn this cap quite a few times and I like it. It's made very well, kinda thick, overlaps the ears good and fits my head perfectly. Now in a hard cold wind tho,,,, you can sorta feel it thru the top of the cap. But wearing a hodie will easily solve this. So for me,,,,,,, keeping my head and ears warm,,,,, it's a great cap. :)

The reviews for this beanie were very good. However, I ordered this one and the Alki'i Premium Cuffed thick mens/womens warm beanie, http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B006QOGKF8/ref=cm_cr_ryp_prd_ttl_hst_2. This one seemed thin and itchy compared to the other, which was thick and soft. I'm not sure why I felt differently from so many other reviewers, but I sent this one back.

I'm very pleased with my cap.  I was a little nervous about the fit at first since it was kind of tight, but it naturally stretched out to fit my large (or fat) head within a day or so.  It is zero degrees F in Wisconsin right now and the cap is keeping my head warm.  Wind does not blow through the knit.. It is hard to beat wool for warmth.
summary: made in USA cap works well

reviewText: This is really a great hat. At first, it was a little tight but after a day of use the wool stretched to be snug rather than constricting. The thickness really helps protect against wind and bitter cold.
Prompt shipment.  Nice fit. A quality clothing item for your cold winter days.  Order one you will be pleased with your purchase.
I wore this cap for 50% of a 30 mile hike and loved every minute of it. It blocks the wind fairly well, keeps you nice and warm and fits great for me.
summary: Warm, not itchy and fits well.

reviewText: Wigwam is the finest wool product maufacturer in America, in my opinion. When I see the Wigwam name I feel I can trust the product quality without hesitation.
This is a well made and warm cap although it is a little tight on my size 71/2 head.  Not uncomfortably tight, just tighter than others.
summary: Overall a great cap; a little tight though

reviewText: It looks just like the picture which is good, but its very itchy. I should of expected that since its made of wool. I didn't pay much attention to that, oops guess thats my fault, wool is itchy. It was kinda small too. Or maybe my head is big. I stretched it over a bowling bowl for a while and it fit fine.

This is a good cap. It is large and has lots of extra room for anyone. If you need a big cap this is the one for you.

It is very comfortable and will suit my needs. Good quality.

I love this hat.  After losing my "official" Army/Navy store cap I struggled to find a new one that was thick enough to keep my head warm, and deep enough to cover the big ole thing.  I have found the solution.  The Wigwam Mills hat is an excellent choice; thick enough so that I never feel wind through the hat, and deep enough for at least a 2 inch fold over.  I noticed that some folks said it was a bit tight.  It does have a snug fit, but I don't find it to be uncomfortable.

Whip out this wonderfully warm cap, from Wigwam Mills, to protect your head and ears.  Yes, it's 100% wool; but is NOT scratchy and the "one size fits all" label is absolutely true.  It stretches to fit any size or shape head.  Reminded me of the cap my dad always wore (more than 60 yrs ago).  Great price, too !  .
Nice warm hat.  Gift for grandson.  He works outdoors at his job all day some days.  It will keep his head warm and look nice on him.  He has sandy colored hair.
summary: Wigwam Mills worsted wool watch cap-black

reviewText: Very nice feel to the wool. Not baby soft but not scratchy either. Feels rugged . Good rich color. Glad i bought this.
summary: good, they run a tad bit tight but it'll stretch most likely

reviewText: This hat is very warm, and fairly comfortable.  I can comfortably walk my dogs in 10 degree weather with this thing!
Excellent quality - all wool - very plain.  Not too attractive but very warm.  If your old cap has worn out, this is the right replacement.

Very nice watch cap. Not to thick or thin and would fit under a helmet just fine. Keep in mind this is not a modern polar fleece wind blocking watch cap, but good ol fashioned wool. Not sure where others are having problems with fit. I have a fairly large head and this thing fits fine. In fact, I could pull it over my head like a ski mask of it had eye holes. Great product.
This cap was ordered because of hair loss from chemotherapy.  It has kept my husband's sexy bald head warm, and it looks good in the process.
Cap is everything it claims to be. Big, warm. quality - and it didn't bunch at the top. Lots of fabric in this hat and it will cover ears without sacrifice. It is a higher quality than surplus caps.

Good basic no frills cap.  High quality wool, no defects I can determine.  Keeps my head warm.  It is not large and floppy.  If you have a big hat size (7 - 7/8 or 8) this cap will be snug but not uncomfortable.

I gave this beanie a five star rating because it is straight quality! It's not too tough and not too soft, but just right. Also, if you live in an area that is cold, not cool but cold, it'll protect you from the elements. Good stuff!
Quality made cap but the size was way too small. Shipping was fast and price was reasonable but I guess i have a big head.
this was a little tight and short on my head.  Not as big and bulky as my old navy watch cap.
My husband works at a government facility near the ocean and is often out in the cold. This cap keeps his head toasty warm.
I like that hat a lot.  It does run pretty big, but overall a quality product. I would recommend it to others.
This hat is nice and warm. I never usually wear this type of hat but I decided to anyways. It's cheap and it's comfortable. I'd definitely recommend this to anyone who's looking for a beanie.

I purchased this hat to wear for work, specifically during the winter months. I work in an environment where it can get down to single digits in temperature. For the price (I paid $12.99 + tax) this is one of the best beanies I've ever had. It is long enough to completely cover my ears and it does a great job of blocking wind.

My only complaint it because of it being wool, it tends to be itchy. With more expensive caps you may get a soft fleece liner, but not in this. I gave it four stars, but would have given it another half if I could. The warmth and price beat out the tiny bit of itch.

This cap seems to have yards and yards of material. By that I mean that even with the rolled up portion, the hat sticks up about a foot (or so it seems) and doesn't sit clost to the top of the noggin.

Bought this hat to replace my Navy watch cap.  It is made of good mateial, but the weave is looser than my original and the wind/cold go through easily on cold mornings.  The ears are protected due to the double layer.  Still looking the the quality of the old, tight weave Navy issue.
This is a very attractive, well made cap. However it didn't have enough stretch to fit the giftee's head so I had to return it. I think it would be most comfortable on an average or smaller head.

I know, I know, this looks like an ordinary hat, rather proletarian, right? Well, unlike many newly manufactured items you are buying this one is made in the U.S.A, of fantastic quality and is good for the money. Well made of quality worsted wool, this simple blue-collar style cap is guaranteed to keep your head warm, and most likely for years to come. Thick, warm and American made, I am more than pleased with this cap, and would definitely look to Wigwam Mills for quality made-in-the-USA products.

I'm only giving this watch cap four stars because, to me, it wears "tight" and seems "scratchy". That said, I recognize it is scratchy because it is 100% wool. However, because it's, "one-size-fits-all, it's cut smaller than what I would consider an average size head thus it feels tight on me after wearing it for awhile.
I would recommend it if you only want to wear it for a short period of time, but go with a polyester of you want more long-term comfort.
Beautiful work, made in America, fits perfect and keeps me warm, A great product.  I would buy from this manufacturer again.

Upon receiving this wool hat it was a bit tight and a little itchy, I washed it in lukewarm water with some hair conditioner, stretched it some, patted dry with a towel and let it air dry. Now it fits good.

I took off a star due to the work that had to be done to make it fit, but the hat is warm and I like it a lot.
summary: Traps the heat, but a little tight.

reviewText:
This is my favorite cap.  Believe it or not, I've bought five of these because I keep losing them.

First, they're wool.  They keep your head warm.

Second, they're wool, which means they shrink.  So, if it starts feeling too loose, run them through the washer.

Third, they're tough.  I wear them at rugby practice.  They keep my head warm and they're snug enough so they don't fall off easily, even after a couple of tackles.  And they haven't fallen apart on me, either.

Fourth, they're better than anything out there.  I compared the following caps, and I keep coming back to the Wigwam Mills.

Rothco GI Watch Cap (smells like chemicals, too loose):

Columbia Watch Cap II (not snug, not easily adjustable)

Smartwool Cuffed Beanie (not bad, but not as good as the Wigwam)
Well made, quality wool watch cap. At first the cap was a little tight, but after wearing it a few times, the wool stretched a bit, and it fits fine.
summary: A great wool watch cap... and it's made in the USA

reviewText: Even doubled up, the wind goes right through this hat.  It's marginally better than the ragg wool gray cap I bought at the same time, but it's still disappointing.
Love it!!!, keeps me warm and cozy. I'm bald so I really need a hat for warmth. Fits just right.
But it doesn't have a lining like the last couple models I bought. What happened to that? Anyone, anyone, anyone?
love the way it fits and how soft that it is, used it up it the mountains it was down in the 30's and it kept me nice and warm
I bought this Cap fits well and super warm you won't go wrong purchasing one of these for the cold winters a head. I highly recommend this cap....
very nice fit, warm watch cap, long enough for rolling up or if u have lots of hair to keep secure.
I keep this cap in one truck to keep warm in the mornings or when the temperature drops. Fits well and is well made.

This hat is warm.  It is too tight.  It is something that can be bought at Target for half the price.  I wear it, i'd recommend you buy it at a Point Of Sale and save a few bucks.
One of those increasingly frequent products i wish i'd not ordered it from Amazon.

The hat is typical Wigwam quality: well knit, well bounded.  They are a bit smaller than expected.  I don't have an out sized head and I find it hard to keep my ears covered and keep the hat out of my eyes at the same time.  Since I got it to keep my ears covered, maybe an inch more hat would have done the trick.

It's a good watch cap and it's extremely well made for the price, it's just a bit too short o do the job I wanted it to do.
summary: Excellent quality; runs a bit small

reviewText: thickness exactly what i was looking for but a little tight got it on time. but im gonna keep it

I was very pleased to see that this product was a LARGE, thick, well made, and comfortable wool cap. Unlike the so-called "SUPERIOR Cotton Knit Cap from "OTTO CAPS" (which turned out to be INFERIOR ), this Wigwam Mills product is everything it was advertised to be and worth the price as well.

I have a large head, not abnormally large, but it's of a decent size.  This watch cap barely fights on my head, and is borderline causing headaches with how snug it is.  I tried to stretch it out over a basketball for almost a week, and it barely stretched at all.  I guess this shows it is of high quality, and it certainly feels like it.  It's just so darn snug, and a little thin.  It seems very warm, and the true test will be during this winter.  I'll try it again, but I'm thinking I may have to give this one to a friend.
summary: Not quite what I expected; tight, thin

reviewText:
This hat was just what I needed to solve the two problems I had at the time:

1 - my head was oft cold.
2 - I didn't look "burglary" enough.

Now I have a cozy warm head AND I look like I'm gearing up to rob a bank! Thanks Wigwam Mills!

As a side note - be careful washing this thing, as it'll shrink a sizeable amount.
summary: Keeps your head warm and your appearance that of a burglar.

reviewText: the cap fits well and will adapt to you head after wearing it for a day or two.  The cap keeps my head comfortably warm on early morning calls.  If only it could make coffee.

This hat is really really warm.  It's the first truly warm hat I've owned that I don't feel ridiculous wearing (like a trapper hat - warm, but silly looking).  It also fits my average sized head really well.  I hate when hats don't come down over my ears fully.  This covers my ears and stays put, even if I'm wearing a ponytail.
It is a bit narrow in the front, not for wide foot. If your food is wide, then this is not for you.
summary: It is a bit narrow in the front, not for wide foot.

reviewText: This size 8 fits my niece who wears size 6, so I either got a shoe with the wrong size or they are really small fitting.

Was so happy that these were true-to-size. The neutral coloring is great for elongating legs, but the metallic at the toe still gives it a little something special. Very impressed by the comfort of the mid-height wedge heel. Really no complaints with these beauties.
summary: Stylish and comfortable! My dream sandal

reviewText: They are very chic but not very comfortable. They did fit true to size and look like the picture. I returned them.

I was really excited about these. However they are too large on my thighs, so they are bunchy and I cannot wear them under skirts, and the seams are cheap. I wore them a couple times but I'll be donating them.

Guys forget the power tie and start using the power thong.  This thong provides minimal coverage while still providing nice support.  If you wear bikinis or briefs, give this a try.  I did and I'm not looking back.

Got these for my Guy. He looks HAWT in them. The fit is average looks are great. Ladies do yourself a favor whip your man into shape and get him in a man thong. He thinks they are the most comfortable thing!

I absolutely love how comfortable these feel! Also, the price was absolutely a steal! (I also bought the 3-pack jockstraps, so I got free shipping)  I will definitely look at buying more Papi Men's brand products in the future.
summary: Papi Men's 3-pack Cotton Thong in White Review

reviewText: These are comfortable to wear all day. Sizes run perfectly. Pouch in front enhances package well eventhough they are not advertised to.
Never worn thongs before and these were suggested to me.  They are extremely comfortable and you don't really feel it when wearing them all day.  They are good quality and will definitely buy more.

When viewing online these looked promising but once received and worn I was not impressed.  When first put on, they do have a very clean look about them especially with the thinner waistband and brightly colored logos.  The styling brings to mind tighty-whiteys gone wild, which is not a bad thing.  The back fit is relatively comfortable for long stretches of time and the rear styling works well visually.

After a day being worn, the positive aspects are outweighed by the negative.  The pouch is very saggy and has no real holding power/support (as mentioned by another reviewer).  They had to be constantly pulled up in the front leaving various male parts to be repositioned several times throughout the day.  There is also the fact that these undies DO NOT conform to your package (probably due to the material being 100% cotton) so if you're looking for a molded fit to show off, you will not find it with these.  I've worn many different brands of thongs over the years and these just don't make the cut in my book.

If you're a slender/slim guy like me (130lbs.), these will not fit. The waist is fine, not too tight & not too loose. Package size is good. The problem is that they're too long, its droopie. Unless I pull them up, above the waist line. But that'll just be plain ridiculous. They should really consider us guys that are slender.

keeps your stuff in place, great for support, only bad thing is the stigmas that only gays can wear thongs but that is quite the contrary.  Feels "free" only really covering your bits so you can wear jeans and shorts without all the bunching which is a giant plus, plus its really cooool so during the hotter days you feel fine and not like your gonna burn up down there, also if you get really sweaty during sports you don't have all the cloth sticking to your legs which gets super annoying.  Overall I'd say a buy product, you shouldn't care what others think just buy what underwear is right for you.

Perfect waistband--not so thin that it rolls, yet not too thick.
Perfect thong/g-string cut does not bind on your nether regions, sits comfortably in place.

Pouch is just large enough to accommodate me, but I am average so if you're significantly endowed you may need a larger size.

Rise is just a hair low for my liking (less than 1" from perfect) but at this price I cannot complain!

You can tell the attention to detail in the fact that the logo is aligned to the front on the actual product, as in the picture.

This is my first Thong and I love it!! Feels really good. Workmanship and quality is great. I barely know I have it on. I'll never wear briefs again. Will definitely purchase more. Shipment was fast!!
These feel so good and give me more support than my briefs. I'll never wear briefs again. Great quality workmanship. Very comfortable. I will definitely purchase more. Shipping was fast.
This bra is of nice quality however the straps are too skinny and dig into my shoulders so even though the bra fits nicely and looks pretty it's very uncomfortable.

I was fitted for a bra at Intimacy in NYC and was shocked to find that I am a 34F.  I had been wearing 36DD's for a while and they never felt quite right.  Good bras are expensive, and that trip put a real dent in my shopping budget, but I was very happy to get this done.  One of the four new bras I purchased was the Panache Melody (in black) and I was sorry they did not have it in nude in my size.  I find this bra very comfortable, even for all-day wear, and the look is trim and neat.  It lifts the girls up and separates them just enough to give a lovely shape under clothing. So happy to see it here in nude.  Great bra for a full-busted woman. The fabric is soft and the lace detailing does not itch at all.  Recommend.

This is a very very pretty bra, however it does have problems. First, it has no padding which for some women is not a problem but for me it can be on those cold days. Secondly, and this was the real deal breaker, the seams show thru. I even tried layering a cami under my shirt and the seams were still visible. This would be a great bra for a thick sweater but I felt it would not get the use it deserved and hence returned it.

As a big bust girl I'm always looking for bras that are comfortable. While it starts out comfartable, this bra is not suitable for a long day. The underwire starts to hurt in the sides after about 5 hours.

The Melody is a terrific bra for my size (40DD). The cup is made in three pieces, for better support. And it's comfortable and delicate, not like those big harness-like things I used to wear before I discovered Panache. Now I won't buy anything else.  It's pricey, but worth every penny. I've purchased expensive bras that fall apart the first time they're laundered, but this bra will hold up (pun intended), and it fits like none other.

Love this bra. Fits well and is really pretty. I will be buying this again. Couldn't be happier. The fit is true -- I'd never bought this brand before, but I took a leap of faith and it worked out. Love, love, love!

This is a nice bra.... I tried it in a 34G and it fits well, except it doesn't come up far enough, so there is "spillage" over the top.  This was the correct size; any larger and it would have bagged in the cups.  This simply isn't tall enough cut for natural breasts not to spill over.
great fit. just as i like it and at a great price.
The bra itself is very pretty, but the top of the cup doesn't round out, so flattens/smushes the topportunity half of the breast and makes it muffin out of the bra edges.
summary: The bra itself is very pretty, but the top of the cup doesn't round ...

reviewText:
I was very disappointed with this bra. I ordered my normal size, 30DD, but the fit is way off. The band was snug, as it should have been, but the underwire dug painfully into my ribs on the side, and the cups were way too large. I probably could have used a B cup in this bra. Sending it back because it's totally unwearable. I think the biggest issue is how uncomfortable the underwire is; it just hits in a strange spot and is very painful.

The bra seems to be decently made, and the material was smooth and soft, but I didn't wear it long enough to comment beyond that.
summary: Cup sizes way off and painful underwire

reviewText: True to size and picture! Comfortable and good quality! I purchased 4!! U can't beat the price!
It's a very flattering and pretty undergarment.

Nothing wrong with the product, just didn't fit me well/do me any favors. I have bottom heavy breasts that are set apart, and balconettes usually fit me best. Just thought I'd post this to help other ladies out.  I'd say the sizing is accurate though.
summary: Not the best fit for me.

reviewText: Love as always !!

This bra is overall ok. I like how it looks and it's flattering on me. But now that I've worn it a couple times it's bothersome how much the underwire and very stiff fabric digs into me, both into my sternum and in my side. It's like it's sewn cheaply and there's not enough material covering the underwire.
A little too functional but comfortable. I'll stick to the Balconettes in the future

This bra just came in, and I've gotta say it fits perfectly! It's hard to find a good bra when you have girls like mine (I wear a 34J in UK sizing) but this bra fits smoothly and is made of super comfy fabric! That is partly because it is a full fit bra - which leads me to the one con, which is that there is nothing sexy at all about this bra. If you get a size that fits, you will have zero cleavage, so save this for your higher necked tops. Otherwise, this is the best bra I've gotten in a long time!

UPDATE: the fabric of the cups really is fantastic, but the underwire definitely pokes me when I bend!  I wore this bra for half a day and had bright red areas of skin where it had been painfully jabbing me as I move.  I have had issues with underwires before, but not quite to this degree - so that's something to keep in mind!
The cup was too big and I ordered a size smaller than I usually.

Good bra very comfortable. My only complaint is that the cups come up very high and compress my chest. It has a minimizing effect that I don't care for.  It's also very hard to wear lowcut tops with this bra.
Seems well made but sizing is way off. Have several bras from this manufacturer and this one is the only one where the size is vastly different - too big in a cup size. Returned right away :(
Perfect fit but the underwire standing a hole under my left arm buy wow the for
summary: Almost perfect the under wire though

reviewText: I really like this bra, but I can only wear it when it truly worth it. I love a bra with wires because the girld need the support but this bra digs into you side like no other which is why I said I wear it when it truly worth it like at a part. I can say folding up tissue and stuffing it under my arm between the wire and my skin helps tremendously. I will say I am build weird, I have a small waist with big breast. I was worth the money

It fits!! I've struggled to find a bra to fit since high school. I bought a 36 K cup, the band is a little tight but I have an extender, so I don't even care because the cup actually fits!! The weight distribution is great, my back feels relieved. Yes yes yes. I will buy again.

Bra shopping is so hard when you can't buy your size in store. This fits ok. I think I just need a smaller size but the under wire rubs under my arm :( I like the quality of the bra itself. It isn't padded like I thought but that isn't a huge deal.
summary: ( I like the quality of the bra itself

reviewText: This is a GREAT bra. Affordable, nice-looking, and comfy - something that's nearly impossible to find with my size!! I am having trouble with the care instructions/size tags on it though, they are HELLA itchy, and sit right between the shoulder blades where it's nearly impossible to reach and scratch at, which is not good when you work 12 hour shifts. Hopefully cutting them off will help.
summary: This is a GREAT bra. Affordable

reviewText: Took a chance and ordered three of these bras. To my surprise they are very comfortable! I'm a 36k. Can't believe the price! I just ordered six more!

Thin and sort of flimsy. Fits well and gives good coverage for bustier ladies (i am a 36 K) i purchased with hopes of being able to wear this at work. It is ok for when i need a good bra for a lower cut shirt or when you want to show cleavage, but forget doing any work in this. Wire is uncomfortable. I am a massage therapist however, so maybe it would be ok if i had a desk job. The lace coverage is elegant, not too old ladyish.
summary: Great fit, elegant look, so so durability and comfort.

reviewText: I own another one of these Panache Melody bras and it is by far one of the most comfortable bras I own.
summary: ... and it is by far one of the most comfortable bras I own

reviewText: Fits PERFECTLY. Band is snug on the loosest setting, central gore is pressed flat against my breastplate, and the underwire goes aaallll the way behind the breast. Nothing jabs, pokes, or squeezes! I cannot stress how important it is that you get a measuring tape and find your bra size before ordering, though. I thought I was a 30F but turns out I was a 32GG. Whoops!
summary: My Soulmate is a Bra (And That's Okay)

reviewText: super comfortable in the early hours of the day, but by the end of the day I was miserable and one of the wires popped out after ONE wash!

First of all, this bra is gorgeous. The lace on the cups is really pretty, and it somehow manages to look sexy even in the color nude.

Okay, onto the important stuff. This bra fits me like a glove in size 32GG. These are UK sizes and it's very important to measure yourself before you buy. Try brasizecalculator.tk for the most accurate calculation.

The fit of the band and cup is exactly as expected - perfect. The straps are comfortable and the gore and underwire don't dig in. Overall, surprisingly comfortable.

Something important to note that may not be evident from the photos Amazon has - there is zero padding in this bra. It is just loose fabric. I have noticed that wearing this when it's very cold may cause a bit of nipple exposure because of this, but it's not too bad.

No weird pointy, cone-shaped, Madonna boobs from this bra either. The shape is rounded and very natural looking.

The lace is not noticeable under a thin shirt either.

For us gals of a larger bust size, we know how difficult it can be to find a bra that fits and is cute, let alone attractive and heaven forbid remotely "sexy".

Enter Panache...

They've created a way for larger busted women to not only be comfortable, but minimize bust line (more on this one in a minute) and still remain cute and sexy!

First...let me tell you...I own Chantelle, Panache, Freya, Fantasie and Wacoal bras.  I'll trade them all in to maintain the Panache line from now on.

Normally, I steer a wide clear left turn away from anything "ette" or "plunge" on bras because, hi, support and spillage much?  Not so with Panache...absolutely full coverage, without risk of falling out and without risk of the dreaded double boob spill out the top.

Am I telling you you can run and jump and cheerlead in this bra?  No.  Don't be silly.  Check out Panache's sports bras for that...game changed with those ladies...game changed.

Now...here's the simultaneous up and down side:
The underwire is WIDE on this.  It's going to take some getting used to.  Read that as "It's going to feel tight and probably painful until you break this bra in".  It's going to pinch under your arms, because that's about where the outer wire stops.  BUT...what happens with a wide set wire?  You look minimized in the bust.  I'm sayin inches here...literal inches look as though they've been reduced from your bust size because your gals are spread back and down and not in a painful "only ice cream can fix this pain" way.  More of a "my favorite shirt that I never wear because I have Madonna circa 1995 bust?  I can wear that now" way.

For the price, you can't beat it.  You won't beat it.  Not even at the department stores overstock shop.

I haven't had any problems with the band slipping down during the day, so you don't have to worry about it suddenly doubling as a belt. The straps are fairly comfortable and don't dig in too much, considering how much they have to hold up.

When I washed them for the very first time, I saw thousands of colorful tiny cloth scraps down along water. The more I washed it, the more scraps coming out!!! I really doubt if these things could be wore as underwear?! I've already thrown away two worst of them.

I wanted some inexpensive, every day panties that were going for comfort over sexiness, and these are doing the job well. The only huge drawback I've found is that you can't really pick what colors you get, but I suppose that's the nature of online shopping. These are no-frills sort of pairs but actually even look reasonably cute in a low-key sort of way, I think, but are made out of fairly nice material for the price and seem to be holding up pretty well after a couple of months of everyday use (though rotating through the pack, obviously).

All in all, I'm very happy, just don't expect fanciness and be willing to accept a grab bag of colors.

reviewText:
So I bought these panties thinking they were sensible- you really can't go wrong with panties in a 6 pack. Apart from the strange ratchet prints on the underwear, I thought they were very good- But I was soo wrong. As soon as I put them on, I realized my back-end was way too large for the panties. My cellulite was oozing all out of the panties, and my lower back was folding over the back top of them. My thighs swallowed them up like fried eggs on Sunday morning. Then, at the very worst time of all, my stomach began to rumble; my chest began to shake- I thought it was a bodily earthquake!
I tried desperately to take off the panties; I tried so hard to save them! But it was too late. The human earthquake had erupted. Maybe if I had bought these panties thirty years earlier, and taken a few X-Lax before hand a few hours earlier, I could have saved myself time, panties, and hard work making the cotton to lift up my huge booty work.
I wouldn't suggest this product for the club, or for any type of wobble dance.
I would however, suggest this product for showing off to your partner- Some people are into that type of tight stuff. Some people like this sexy cellulite.

My review title sums up how I think of these undies. I did not purchase them from Amazon but have been buying the same 6-packs from my local Target for many years where I can get them for $6, and once in awhile they even throw in a "free +1 pair". Having bought numerous packages, I can tell you that the sizes aren't consistent. That is, a size "5" for example, will vary in how in how it's cut, how low the hip is, and in overall size, so even if YOU don't change, there's no exact telling that a particular size will always be the right one for you.  Eventually, they all wear out.  Yes, I understand, underwear isn't meant to be owned for life, but I mean they wear out in fairly short order.  The color fades, the booty gets baggy, and almost ALWAYS the elastic at the waist or leg starts to unravel.  You see a little unraveling thread start on these, and it's all over.

So why do I buy them?  At $1/pair, it's a fairly reasonable trade to me to get cute, no-frills, cotton hipsters (in various colors and patterns) that typically have good derriere coverage. If I found a comparable replacement, I'd stop buying these (I think Hanes are just as cheaply made).

Edit Jan 2013:  So it'd been awhile since I bought any of these from Target as I was really trying to kick the Fruit of the Loom undie habit since I invariably regret it.  But I checked my local Target this week and they've jumped in price to $9.99.  No way I'd pay more than a buck a pair for these so unless they go on sale (there or here - the latter of which seems unlikely), I won't buy them.  It's a shame 'cause it's nice to have all cotton underwear sometimes, especially in summertime. (Sweat and nylon are a bad combo, especially in underwear.)
These are true hipsters which is what I wanted.  They fit well and wash well.  They arrived in a timely manner and I wouldn't hesitate to order from them again.

See the pretty little patterns on the undies in the photo advertising the product? Aren't they cute? Yeah, that's not for you. You get boring washed out faded solid colors, sucker. If Amazon keeps lying to me about what I am buying I guess I'll have to shop brick and mortar. Bait and switch is never acceptable, not even in underwear. Isn't it illegal to falsely advertise a product in this way? Oh Amazon, why do you hate your customers so much?
summary: ONCE AGAIN, ITEM NOT AS PHOTOGRAPHED :(

reviewText:
Living just north of Atlanta I was caught last winter without real winter boots. I had to use my low top hiking shoes when shoveling snow and ice. Although they are water resistant they were designed for hiking and small puddles/streams. After a couple of minutes I had wet frozen ankles and socks, I was determined to purchase proper winter boots. These fit the bill and then some!

Size/Fit:
After reading many reviews claiming that they run tight (due to the inner filling taking up space) I decided to try these on at a local NorthFace Outlet. Although they did not carry the color I wanted, they did have my size. Reveiwers are 100% correct. These run about 1 size smaller then your normal size. So if you normally wear a size 10, you'll need to go up to at least a size 11. If you have flat or wide feet maybe go up 1 1/2 size. The combination of the inner filling and wearing a standard winter sock takes up a lot of space in the shoe. However once on you do not feel like your wearing a shoe that is one size to big. They fit me like they were made for my feet. Snug, but not to tight. Physically these boots are large, regardless of your shoe size. They are bulky (in a good way), serious winter boots.

Boot Weight:
These boots are very light weight. The size of the boot make it look like it should weigh a ton, but the materials are modern, lightweight and durable. I have dress shoes that weight more then these. You should easily be able to walk/hike/work all day and not feel like you have a 10 lb weight strapped to your feet.

Construction/Quality:
The materials appear to be of good quality. The fit and finish is what you would expect of a brand like North Face. They look and feel like high quality boots. The seams are tight, the bonding of the rubber lower and leather upper is tight and waterproof. The laces and lace eyelets are quality and solid. The upper quick lace grove is plastic, which is my only concern. It has not caused a problem, but I expected to see a more durable metal instead of plastic.

In Use:
At first they seem very stiff, and they are. These are serious boots meant for serious weather. Perhaps a bit overkill for my needs, but I'd rather have to much boot then to little. They do break in after some use making walking in them less "Ski-Boot" like but don't expect these to feel like sneakers. These are easy on your feet and dampen the impact of normal walking. On uneven surfaces like rocks, dirt or forest they excel and keep your feet from tiring, excellent cushioning and treads.
The inner filling keeps your feet warm without overheating and causing sweat. However if you are working all day or very active in these you will sweat just like in any other shoe/boot. I cannot say how they handle in temperatures below 19 degrees as It hasn't gotten lower then that where I live so far, however at 19 degrees they were warm and toasty.
So far they are completely waterproof. As a test I left them 1/2 way submerged (just above the seem of rubber and leather) over night and the inside was completely dry the next morning.
***UPDATE 2/19/15 ***
It was 9 degrees this morning and I spent an hour outside clearing ice and salting the driveway and walkways. The boots performed great. Very warm and great traction on the slippery surfaces. I only wish I had gloves that kept me as warm.

Bottom Line:
These are great winter boots that mean business. They look great on your feet and the quality and feel give you confidence that your prepared to face the elements. Once you put them you feel like your ready for the next Sno-Mageddon! I picked them up for a steal during an Amazon boot sale event and am very happy with my purchase. Even at regular price I would buy them again as they are very reasonably priced for what your getting.
summary: Awesome boots, go up at least one size.

reviewText: I was walking around in the snow carrying our toddler when suddenly I felt like I was wearing nothing but socks. I looked down and I couldn't believe it -- these North Face boots SPLIT IN HALF and I had to end our adventure short and go back to the car with cold and wet feet. I only used these lightly for 6 years, with less than 5 miles on the boots total over this period. The rest of the time I kept them in a shoe box in the closet. These boots feel stiff compared to other boots on the market that are more comfortable, but I figured that extra stiffness (and the North Face brand name) means that they are more durable. But it turns out quite the opposite. After the boots broke apart I looked at the label: Made in China. North Face has been one of my favorite brands for my mountain clothing (I have North Face ski clothing from 15 years ago, I still use today and looks like new) so it is unfortunate to see that they are risking their brand name by Made in China quality. I'm sure they will replace these Chinese boots under the lifetime warranty, but if this happens when you are on a long hiking trail in freezing conditions they're not going to send replacement boots out there when you need them the most.
summary: FELL APART while hiking in snow

I live in South Africa, but I'm heading to Siberia, I bought these puppies on recommendation that they work down to -30 Centigrade and are water-proof (from photographic forums). It truly competes against much more expensive boots in the same category such as Salomon winter boots and a steal for $100.

Honestly, I was skeptical about the TNF Winter Grip rubber outsole
Because we have no snow in Africa and its generally pretty warm, the best place I could try the ice-gripping soles was at an ice-rink. So after skating a bit on the ice I stuck these boots on and stepped onto the rink, they had amazing grip!
It ended up with me doing a foot race against a colleague, which although I lost, I was able to run pretty fast? At the amazement and amusement of friends I stepped off the ice and was accosted by the ice rink management, I explained that they were Ice-boots and that it was all okay, to which the management responded "We can see they're Ice-boots, but you're making all the kids think they can run on the ice with normal shoes"!
I am guessing the pieces of the TNF Winter Grip sole are made of some sort of carbon, as they are harder and had much better grip on the ice and the surrounding rubber acts as a sort of stabilizer.

Sizing
Other reviews are spot-on about the small size, I normally wear a size 10, but ordered the 11, a full size up.
The size up made it comfy wearing two pairs of thick socks and not tight at all - if you really want to know, foot dimensions are:
9.44 x 3.93 x 2.55 inches ( Length x Width at ball of foot x Width at heel)

Next Tests
* The waterproof test
* Getting into an industrial fridge to test the functionality at -30 degrees centigrade.
summary: A Review From South Africa - Heading to Siberia - Impressed So Far!

CONS:
Sizing: Based on reviews here, I ordered a Medium.  I'm pretty small, with a fairly "rectangular" build, and small bust. The new 'Tatiana' style by Nine West is very hot.
I have three colors so far and I'm thinking hard about buying two more.

The shape and style of the shoe is sculpted but the heel is stark and square to my eye.
Since the heels are so very tall 'Tatiana' positively screams 'Sexy!' when I wear them.

The square heels tone the shoes down enough for me to wear to work.
I've worn my 'Tatiana' heels with long slacks and suits at the office.

In my normal Nine West size, the fit is good... snug but not too tight... I didn't need any cushions or pads.
The length and width are just right for me.
I've had no slip-offs or walk-outs so my 'Tatianas' don't need an ankle strap.

The toe is pointy and I have some pinching after about four or five hours of wear.
All good... I just dangle one on my toes for a few minutes while I'm sitting at my desk with my legs crossed then switch.
I imagine the leather will relax a little bit with a few more wearings.

I would have preferred a sculpted heel instead of the square geometric style but that would have put 'Tatiana' into the over-the-top-sexy category and I wouldn't feel right wearing them to work.

The quality of the leather and the construction is good for the price... I expect my 'Tatianas' to last for several seasons.

reviewText:
Cute and comfortable are the words for this shoe. I wear a lot of skirts and dresses and need a shoe that is comfortable but also looks good with a dress. These are a great choice for summer with their mary jane and sneaker styling and their Dansko comfort. They run true to size too - perhaps a bit smaller than the classic Dansko clog with its boxy shaping, but I ordered my usual size and wore them right out of the box. A good shoe and a good deal. Recommended for those who want both style and comfort.

Dansko Sizing is pretty straightforward except for those who wear a Size 8. If you are a small 8, order the 37, if you are a large 8 order the 38 and if you are closer to an 8 1/2 order the 39. Other sizes are translated pretty clearly in the sizing chart. These do run true to Dansko sizing as I own 4 pairs of shoes and one of boots in the Dansko brand.

I was very skeptical because of the way they look, but the ortho told me I needed to wear these to help with a stress fracture in my foot.  It is amazing how comfortable they are.  I cannot walk in any other shoes without a limp.  I can tell that I will be able to wear these on vacation and walk a long way.  I am very happy.
Love this clog!  Very comfortable and stylish.  I'm on my feet most of the day and these shoes don't tire my feet.  I have 5 pairs of Danskos.  I haven't been disappointed yet.

I got these shoes in the khaki color and I just love them!  They are so comfortable and go with so many outfits from sporty to casual business.  I have a fairly wide foot and did not have the problem the previous reviewer mentioned.  I love that I can just slip them on without socks.

I bought the Dansko Volley, and thought the Valerie might be fun to wear with skirts.  Thinking that they might be a similar fit, as they are both made of canvas, I got the Blue Hawaiian, which was a really perky shoe.  I have medium/wide feet, but usually Danskos fit me fine.  I ordered my regular Dansko size.  While it was long enough, and actually wide enough in the toe box, the stiff fabric at the top of the vamp cut into the top of my foot.  As cute as they are, I had to return them, because I would never be able to wear them for more than ten minutes.  If you have narrow feet, give them a try...they are insanely cute!
Wear great!! Comfortable!!! I've even washed them in the washing machine.

I was nervous about buying these over a year ago, because most Dansko clogs are too wide for me, but these are fantastic shoes. They provide great arch support and traction, so I can wear them all day with very happy feet. It took a little while to wear them in - I am an overpronater, so I like a secure shoe.

They have a low heel which comfortable and gives me a little boost. And they have just enough of that Converse vibe, without looking silly. I wear them with jeans and capris, and even after a year, still get complements on them on a regular basis. They can get hot when it is 90+ and I get overheated, but they haven't gotten stinky and I am supersensitive to that. I keep meaning to put a thin insole in...I love having a cute shoe that I can walk 4 miles in if I have to.

My biggest regret is not buying these in more colors when they were available.
summary: Quite possibly one of the cutest sneakers ever
