read the reviews I really hoped this shoe, I ordered my usual size, but they are small, they rubbed my feet and make blisters, they are heavy not as comfortable as she wanted, maybe they on a narrow foot, I do not share the rave reviews and if it would be opportunity to be returned to them, but others maybe they will fit.

I again ordered the same size I wear in Sanita's and they were to tight across the toes and I have a somewhat narrow foot, I wore them around the house trying to stretch them but I gave up and sent them back.
I like these shoes.  They fit my wide feet well, had minimal break in time, and have room in the toes.  They have a classic look to them and look cute with all my casual dresses.
My third pair of Dansko's Valerie.  These will do well with jeans. I wear them when I know I have a lot of walking scheduled.
I love Dansko.  I bought them because I needed a show for work that was near but supportive.  I get  compliments on them everyday.

I am a big fan of the Dansko clogs, and generally they run true to size or a bit large for me, so I ordered these without even thinking they wouldn't be perfect. Since they were canvas, I also thought they would stretch a little bit over time when they were, in fact, a little tight in the upper (Not the fit, they are wide enough, deep, enough, etc,) part where it crosses the bridge of my foot; the 'arc' at the toe box as it were. They don't. The don't stretch even a little, because the edge stitches are a super tine, super tight, extra not-at-all stretchy cotton binding of some kind intent on cutting off all the circulation in my feet. I definitely can't wear them with any kind of sock thicker than a knee-high.

I bought them for spring and summer wear and since that's when feet swell, well, unless I lose weight in my feet, these might go to a skinnier footed person. Sadly, they are the 'right' size in the width, length, etc, all the parts where a shoe is measured, they just aren't 'tall' enough.
These fit perfect. I ordered my regular size--no need to go up or down a size. They bothered my foot across the top the first couple of wearings, but are very comfortable now. Super cute!

Okay, for most people Dansko shoes are "grandma" style but I really want to care for my feet so decided to try them out. I am usually a size 7.5 in a women's fitted dress shoe and that leaves me with just enough wiggle room for foot expansion/swelling at the end of the day. Due to the size conversion these fit more like a 7.75 (if that makes sense). At first I thought they would feel too big and clunk around but throughout the day they felt secure (I am sure the strap helps with this). Usually when I wear a new pair of shoes the first day you can feel the break-in but since these are molded to what your foot needs my first day in these felt like my 20th in any other type of shoe. And I work with high school students, the girls actually commented on how cute they are, thank goodness because I really though they would make fun of my "grandma" shoes, lol, I will definitely purchase another pair in the future!

I have several pairs of Dansko shoes, all size 40 (I will note I do not wear a 40 in other brands, only Dansko.)  I ordered a 40 in this shoe and it is at least two sizes too big.  I cannot address comfort since it doesn't fit properly.  It is a cute casual shoe, but be careful when ordering sizes.
This is my second pair of Danskos. They are lightweight, adorable, and comfortable especially if you have a foot problem like mine.  I couldn't be happier.
I've had a nueroma in the ball of my foot and find it painfull to wear any kind of shoe but open sandals.  I can wear this shoe all day without pain.

I am enjoying these Dansko Valerie Canvas shoes. I received them two days ago and I am wearing them every chance I get. Usually I hold onto new shoes and ponder if I want to return them, but it didn't take long to commit to this shoe.

I typically wear a 7, occasionally 7.5, and the 38 fits well, slightly on the large side which is very typical for Danskos. They are easy to slip on and they look nicer for errands than running shoes. They have a nice sturdy, slightly heavy sole so they feel substantial. And the best part is they have great arch support! Great shoe, especially for the price.
These shoes cut across the top of my foot. I have only worn them once, and I'm not sure if I will try to wear them again.
Didn't even need to break them in.  Started wearing them on vacation and was doing a lot of walking.  So comfortable.  Will definitely consider getting some in other colors.
great shoes, fit well except across the top so I had to take mine to get them stretched  but love them

These shoes lived up to my every expectation.  I wore them for three days in Disneyland.  My feet did not hurt, no blisters formed, and the shoes were brand new at the time I wore them.  Most comfortable shoes I've ever had!!
I love these shoes. I've gotten many compliments on them. It's my first pair of Dansko and I'm looking to buy more. They're totally worth the price.
This shoe fit large in length  loved the style. I  trying a smaller size this year  the clog footbed has been a boon to my feet
I love these shoes.  I have them in 3 colors and bought another pair as a backup in case they quit making them. They are true to size, comfortable to walk in all day, and sharp looking.
Just got a pair of sand colored today and ordered another in navy. Just precious and make my feet feel oh so good.
This is my second pair of Dansko in this style. They are very comfortable for all day wear. Looking forward to lots of wear!!

These shoes fit great!!  My doctor suggested Dansko shoes and I put them on as soon as I received them.  My foot felt better within hours.  It doesn't hurt to walk any more. I ordered another pair two days later.  I have arthritis in my big toe and this is the first relief  I've found.

great fit and comfortable...go with anything! Good support for arthritic feet!!The sand color will do real well
In the summer!

Love these! Love how they fit around the toes and the adjustable (and stretchy) strap as well as the color. The only issue for me is that the ankle was a bit wide. This is the second pair of Dansko's where I have this issue. It's almost as if, by the Dansko sizing chart, I wear a B width along the foot but an A width around the ankle. The sole is quite dense and if it weren't quite as heavy I might have been able to keep them, but since the ankle area was too big for me they just kept sliding off. :(
Wish I could have kept them!
summary: Gorgeous and with great arch support and excellent quality

reviewText: These were just as I thought they would be.  I read a review from one of amazon's buyers and decided to buy a size smaller in these and I wished I hadn't.  They fit okay but are just a little snug.
I like the Mary jane shoe for the summer will go nicely with many things with the neutral color and design
I bought this shoe in december and the soles are worn thin so much for the non slip angl. Also has no arch support.
Was tight over the front enough to leave marks; I usually have a good fit with dansko; also, noisy sounding on hard floors

I tried these shoes because they have such a good reputation.  I think they are the most comfortable shoes i have worn in a long time..  Perfect for work.  I was worried they would be too small as i wear a true 8.  I bought the 38 and it is perfect. slightly big in the ankle but with socks it will be perfect. i have to agree with the other reviews that say it is tight at the top.  i am hoping it will stretch.

The fit is good.  Just a little heavy is the reason for 4 stars.
Love the arch in these shoes.

This is my second pair of Valerie Mary Janes. I wanted something that slipped on quick to walk the dog and the pink flowery ones were on sale for like $15 or so - dansko so cheap? You bet!! I wore those all last summer and have a tan line to prove it. These khaki ones just go with more things. Still as comfy - look cute at the end of my feet. I have the tennis shoes like this too in black and red. I'm sad they don't have those any more.
This is my second pair of these shoes. They are very comfortable! True to size and love the colors. Great summer shoe.
I wore these while on set for Universal Studios and my feet didn't hurt at all. They were perfect! Definitely worth it.
summary: Perfect shoe for a makeup artist

reviewText: This shoe was so hard on the feet, my feet felt like they were encased in concrete. A very clunky shoe.
Love love love this shoe!! So many compliments. I wear in the OR, with green scrubs and it can be washed off. Wears super well! Fun shoe great comfort!! Love to buy other colors!!
really like the look of this shoe.  it is a bit tighter than I expected across the top as Danskos usually are wide.  But since it is canvas, I think it should stretch out a bit.

dansko are the best shoe ever period for the active mom, of today i used this for just about everything and they look great with dresses too.agreat if you have heel pain like me
.
summary: Just what my feet need it.

reviewText: These shoes are comfy as most Dansko shoes are. They work just fine for every day, around town sneakers. They are very cute. Obviously they match nothing, but it just gives you an adorable quirky look, right? That's what I tell myself anyway. I have to clean the toes off pretty frequently, but that could just be because I'm a klutz. But they clean off easily with a damp cloth, so no prob. I got them for, like, $27 and it was very well worth it.

Large in length but tight across the top of my toe. When I wore them for the first time they started to rub my heel. I like the design and color, quite solid and felt comfortable under foot. I've had some admirers from work colleges who have asked about them.  I'm still getting use to these American sizing as I find the letters after the number size a bit confusing. Officiously the M is not quite right for me.
I really haven't worn this pair of shoes yet as saving for a vacation.  Really cute though and feel comfy when walking around at home.
Comfortable and yet they keep my feet and body in alignment.  Recommend these for all women with foot problems or back pain.

Im somewhat overweight, walk all day on concrete and have plantar fascitis.  These shoes have a deep enough footbed that I can take out the provided insole and put in my orthotic insoles.  I don't wear anything but Danskos anymore because I don't want to feel my feet when I get home.  If I wear these, my feet don't hurt or burn.

The black sneaker/ballet slipper look is acceptable at work.  In fact, I even wear them with skirts, which I don't feel comfortable doing in the professional clog.  Also, the canvas is nice and airy.  I don't have to wear socks or worse yet, nylons, with these.  I just slip them on and go.  Ive got easily 10 pairs of Danskos.  But I haven't bothered to wear any others except these and the same style in pink flowers since I bought these.

They are perfect for a teacher like me to feel comfortable and still look somewhat dressed up.

I had foot surgery in April and I am getting too excited to wear cute shoes too fast. The incisions on the top of my foot are still sore and of course that is where these shoes hit me. Next summer they will be way more comfy and it will look like I have a brand new pair of shoes! So I get double lucky, my foot all healed and a fabulous virtually brand new  pair of Danskos to tip toe through the tulips in! Amazon, Great buy Great Service!
summary: Dansko, what is not to love?

reviewText: I already had this shoe in sand, but the pattern is so FUN. They fit well and I feel spunky. I can walk in style.

The shoes are comfortable and fit well.  I wear them daily.  Before I got them, I suffered from painful plantar fasciitis.  It hurt to walk, and nothing seemed to help, not even Dr. Scholl's orthopedic insoles.  But these fixed the problem right up, no more pain!!! I SWEAR by these shoes.
summary: These Shoes Cured My Plantar Fasciitis!!!

reviewText: Bought these for wearing casual in the office.  I have major foot problems, and got the cheapest Dansko's I could find ( I have other Danskos, too) ... These are amazingly comfy.  Love em!

These shoes are comfortable and sturdy.  I would like to be able to buy 1/2 size smaller; I bought the 36, which is a U. S. size 5.5-6, and they're a little large even though I'm normally a size 6.  I wouldn't wear these without socks.  The strap helps to hold them on, but now that I have them I wish they were slip-ons--that would just be more convenient.  These also don't look quite as cute in reality as in the picture online.  The black canvas and rubber toe aren't quite as dark black as they look in the picture, and the whole shoe does look a bit clunky, as clogs do.  However, I do appreciate having space for my wide toes.  I think the Emmy Fashion Sneaker in black might be a better choice if you're looking for a really dark black shoe.
summary: Sturdy shoes, a little large and clunky

reviewText: I have a whole shoe closet and I gaze upon them everyday to match my outfit for the day. They r the most comfortable shoe I own. Every pair is classic construction, easily washable and look fantastic even after the years go by. This is my 7th  pair and, of course, I'm in love. My older ones look fabulous A great buy!
very nice shoes there a little big but not bad wear them a lot would by another pair no problem

I had a big injury in the ball of my foot and the challenge of the last 2 years has been to find a shoe that is comfortable and looks good. These shoes have finally provided all day comfort.
Have ordered 3 more pairs :)
Of any shoe out on the market today Danskos are comfortable and always have cute styles, the right width and arch support for my feet!
They are wonderful shoes with the exception of the width. They seem to run narrow. I am using a shoe stretcher to see if I can widen them just a little bit
I love my Dansko, but I'm finding it hard to fit many of the styles I want. Thanks for trying, I just have small feet.
I like how they fit and also the price.  I hope they aren't going to discontinue this shoe!  I am having trouble finding this shoe.
Not as comfortable as I expected...I couldn't make it all the way through my 8 hour shift...Oh well. Can I still return?

This is my second pair of canvas Danskos for work.  The arch support and sole feel great.  No sore feet the next day.
The only problem is that they are not a little large for stated size, I wear a size 10 US and the toe box on these is a little tight. I am hoping that they stretch out a little there. Otherwise they are colorful and comfortable.
I find this shoe to have a terrific supporting arch and is very comfortable.  And it looks great with my scrubs.  Lots of compliments.

I have high arches and the adjustable strap works great for me.  The beds are very comfy and good for when I'm on my feet a period of time.  I wear a size 10 and probably could've gone down a size to a 40 so the 41 is true to a 10.5/11.  I love that the Mary Jane style is not to clunky looking .

This is my second pair because I wore out my other!  They are comfortable for all day wear, easy to match with dresses, pants, and shorts and after a brief break-in period, never gave my feet problems, even without socks.  Perfect summer shoe!!!

Fits good, nice arch support, well made, really cute, would recommend to a friend.
I really like them, my feet are happy.
Not bad. I heard good things about how comfy dansko shoes are. I'm on my feet a lot and have a lot of foot pain. These are ok. I still get my heal pain from time to time.
summary: Comfy Vegan shoes are hard to find

reviewText: You can't go wrong with Dansko.  The shoe is cute and very comfortable. I wear them standing hours on end. They are a bit heavy, but I can understand why with the rubber sole.  Slip resistant.  I'm very happy with them
summary: Very comfortable right out of the box

reviewText: Love love love these. . Super cute. Super comfortable. Lighter than regular dansko clogs but just the same fit and internal feel. Canvas is surprisingly easy to keep clean. And the red pattern is much more versatile than you would think.

This particular shoe is great for my lifestyle.  I spend half my weekends on swim meets which require lots of walking, standing and moving over a wet surface.  The rubber soles which go higher than on a usual shoe protects me from getting wet feet, from sliding over the wet floors, and they provide more comfort to a person who has to stand and walk for over 6 hrs/day.  The classic feminine look appeals to me.  This shoe reminds me of times when life was less hectic and more enjoyable.  The fabric lets the feet breath, which in turn may prevent bad odors and fungal infections.

I have tried on a number of Dansko clogs in various shoe stores and I always have the same problem - my left foot is too big but my right foot fits perfectly. There are times I can't even get my left foot into the shoe. I didn't have that problem with this style and I am very pleased. The left foot was pretty tight at first, but the shoe stretched in just the right way to accommodate my foot.
If I wear these too long while standing for long periods, they do start to hurt the top of my foot, where the toe starts. I think that's just from foot swelling though.
They fit surprisingly well, and maybe run a little wider than traditional Dansko clogs.
The shoes are super cute though they are a little heavier than other shoes of this style. But I don't feel like they weigh me down in anyway.
Update: After wearing these shoes for only a little over a month, the canvas started to tear from the sole. However, I contacted Dansko directly and they responded right away with an offer to replace them. I really appreciate the great customer service but I also wish the shoes had lasted a reasonable amount of time.
summary: Love them - but they wore out

reviewText: I had hopes for these shoes as they are on the clunky, chunky side and I hoped this would accommodate my high instep.  Unfortunately they did not.  I'll probably have to give up buying shoes on-line as I've had this problem before.
love love and very cute with jeans. If you know your size its a great way to order a new style.

I have 6 pairs of these shoes.  I wear. Them everyday.  This pair is actually a replacement for the pair I have worn out after wearing them for 2 years.  I heard a rumor dansko was discontinuing this style so will have to stock up
I now understand why people say these are the most comfortable shoes. I have ordered this same pair in black.
I HAVE HAD 2 BACK SURGERIES & LOVE THESE SHOES. THEY DONT HURT MY BACK, LEGS..... PLUS THEY ARE SO CUTE!

For my big feet, these really do look good on my feet.  The bottom is fairly rigid, so this worked well for me since I have arthritis in my toes and don't need a shoe to bend (little or at all).  They are super cute too.....I've gotten lots of compliments on them.

Bought them for a trip to europe because I didn't want to look like the tourist in sneakers.  Wore them the first full day, and had to buy some birkenstocks. The shoe performed well (comfortable just to wear) but the top of the shoe digs into your foot just above your toes when you walk in them. NOT COOL!

I wear these shoes often!  They are great support for my feet and they are so cute!  They have a little heal on them and I find that to help in the comfort of the shoe.  I am on my feet a lot on concrete floors and they give me all I look for in a good work shoe.  When these wear out I will probably order another pair.  Dansko did it right with this one!

canvas was slightly less formal than expected.  at first thought heel would be rubbing but because of loose heel fit like all my clogs (that I'm used to and expected) it is just fine on the heel.  love the comfort, support, and high durability expected as all dansko shoes.
I have issues with my feet, but I now have two pair to wear.  They are the most comfortable shoes.
Very stiff shoes, must wear socks to avoid BLISTERS!  The edges will cut even though I have worn these shoes for some time.
a very pretty shoe but to narrow for my foot.  My main complaint though was the weight.  They are so heavy its like walking around with cement block shoes.  Afraid I have to return them
I love these as I do all my other Dansko shoes!  Comfortable and a very versatile shoe. I wear them with long pants or short.
These are comfortable with decent support, but like my other Danskos (the classic style), it took a few wearings for the top of my foot to get used to it.
Great shoe for wanting a casual, yet professional look.  I'm on my feet a lot and can stand comfortably in this shoe for long periods of time.

This shoe has become my goto shoe when I want to dress up a bit. They are very comfy and have some height to them without the discomfort. I just bought a black pair and I love them also. Can wear with pants, shorts, or dresses.
I had surgery on my foot which required shoes that give stability, have room for orthotics, and are comfortable. Also, I am able to dance in these shoes and I love the style.
So comfortable.  So cute!  Great price!  Excellent arch support.  Look cute with both pants and skirts.  What could be better?

The shoe itself was awesome, but the ridge across the top of the shoe was very stiff and tight. I ended up not wearing them more than a couple of times before summer hit. I really want these shoes to work so I will give it a try again come jean weather. I have really bad back problems and bought these on the recommendation of a friend. I think if I bought the next size up they would have been too long and big. I have high arches :-( Still not ready to give up on them!
Too me they are true to a Dansko fit.  If anything, they are a tiny bit on the roomy side for me as my foot is a little on the thin side.  Happy to have them!

These are great! All the comfort of Dansko for half the usual price because they are canvas, which I actually like better. They look good with pants and skirts. The rubber toe is nice as it does't show scuffs the way my old leather Dansko did.

Since I've worn these shoes only once, this review is preliminary and may be updated later on.  Though a bit heavy, the Dansko Women's Valerie Canvas shoes are fairly comfortable and supportive.  Take note - these shoes are medium width but they fit my wide feet quite well; if you usually wear a medium width shoe, you might find these to be too big for you.
The one problem I found is that while the left shoe fits perfectly, the right shoe is a little too long resulting in my heel slipping.  I like the shoes enough to not want to send them back, so I need to find a way to remedy that problem.  Once I do, I'm hoping that I'll get a good bit of wear out of them.  Worn with tights, I think these Danskos could be quite fun and stylish for Fall.  To be continued . . .
Shoes too heavy and uncomfortable. Not what I expected from Dansko. Looking for comfortable walking shoes for upcoming trip. Chose Dansko from a referral from a friend. Wrong!
very heavy shoes. feel more like 10.5 than 11.5. I wore them for a couple of hours to see if they would give a little. Wish I had just sent them back.

I own a good amount of Dansko shoes and I must say, this one is not my favorite.  This, like many Dankso shoes, are made for people with wide feet.  I have long and skinny feet so my foot moves around a lot in this particular shoe.  After the first day of wearing it, I got a blister on the back of my heel from it rubbing against the material.  I bought a pair of those Dr. Sholls heel liners and those have done wonders.  They are a lot more comfortable on the back of my heel, but my feet still do move around quite a bit.  If you have long and skinny feet like I do I would consider the Veda clog over this one.  The Veda clog has laces and fits better to your foot.
I wanted a shoe that felt like a comfortable sneaker but looked like a dress shoe.  This fit the bill exactly and at a great price!

I own a hair salon and I'm on my feet all day.
I buy supportive shoes every year and this is my second purchase of these Danskos.
They are cute with  skirts as well as jeans!  I wear them every day.

I'm a huge Dansko fan, so getting these shoes on a sale price was great.  I ordered the red Hawaiian design.  I find that this style is more comfortable that the classic clog from Dansko...I get tons of compliments!
Ordered here in black for my roommate who has heel spurs and low arches. She has lived in them since they arrived, and has gone back to order them in other colors.
summary: wonderful for tender heels and low arches

reviewText: These shoes are very well made. Great color that will go with lots of outfits. If I weren't between sizes these would be more than perfect.

I bought these because I wanted a more summery Dansko shoe to wear in the warmer weather. Overall, I'm quite pleased with them. They're cute, and they have the arch support I need from Dansko. I do find the strap a little uncomfortable after I've been wearing them for a while, and they are heavier than your usual summer sandal, but for someone like me who really needs a supportive shoe, they are a good choice.
I like these shoes.  They are kind of pricey but worth it.  they look good with jeans, shorts, capris... Comfortable too!

BUT LOVE THEM NEEDS A BIT OF BREAKING IN DUE TO CANVAS OVER INSTEP BEING QUITE TIGHT BUT A LITTLE RUBBING ALCOHOL WILL LOOSEN UP THE INSTEP UPPER FABRIC, OVERALL GREAT AS WELL AS ROCKER PANEL IS WONDERFUL, STRAP COULD BE WIDER AND EWIGHT COULD BE A TAD LESS,

I recently had back surgery and was in search for a comfortable and durable shoe.  I am so happy that I got this shoe. It fits perfectly and is very comfortable to walk and stand in.  I liked the way it was packaged. It is worth every penny.  I certainly would recommend this shoe to anyone looking for comfort, style and hopefully durability.
Shoe has little arch support but after wearing them for a while I don't notice. I had to get used to these I had a blister after a long walk. Short walks are fine.
These are great vegan dress shoes that look nice with jeans, dress pants, skirts, and dresses. They feel very comfortable. My only complaint is that they don't do well in the rain!

I bought these shoes for my mom, because she is on her feet for 10 to 12 hours at a time. She loves wearing them, and gets many compliments. They support her feet, and make her feel comfortable on her longest days of working at art shows. I use Dansko shoes for teaching, and have bought about 8 pairs in my lifetime so far. I think EVERY teacher should have a pair of cute Mary Janes to wear during a long day of teaching on your feet. If you rarely sit down at a desk, this is the shoe for you! :)
The heel bed is slightly different from the clogs and not as much of a heel, but overall very comfortable.  I only buy Danskos; that kinda says it all.

These shoes fit great. They are very comfortable. I have been wearing them with my capris and skirts this summer and they look great. If you need shoes that are going to be comfortable for standing or walking all day at work, these shoes are it
Very comfortable right out of the box with no break in required.  I love them so much I have two pairs.

I get a lot of compliments whenever I wear these shoes!  They are really cute and somewhat comfy (I still need to break them in a little).  The only downside is how heavy they are, but they give a great amount of support!  Perfect if you need to be on your feet al day!
The shoe physically fit, but cut into the top of my foot, making it impossible to wear. It was returned, which is a shame because the quality was very good.

I have had a long bout with plantar fasciitis.  After 5 months in a cast, these are the shoes I ordered to help me regain my mobility.  I love them.  The toe box is roomy and they are just "cute".  I have the Valerie in black leather, so I knew they were comfortable shoes.  This canvas one is great for summer.
I love the Dansko products they make my feet happy.  This product did not disappoint.  The colors are great and the fit is as expected.

Love these shoes!  I get compliments every time I wear them. They are very comfortable, true to size, and the colors are great. I live in the South, so wearing tennis shoes in the summer with socks can be so hot and uncomfortable. These shoes don't need socks, so your feet can breathe and stay cool during those hot summer months.  I highly recommend!

I am on my feet all day and look for options to tennis shoes. These are supportive enough for me to wear for an 8 hr day and they're super cute. I had to order in several colors because they worked so well.
Fits as expected and cute for any outfit.  If Comfort is the key, for me it is and this shoe has it.

It's so nice to get a good supportive shoe that is also cute. The shoe is a little more narrow than the plain orange ones I purchased last Summer at the store. I was surprised to find a difference between the two. It's not TOO narrow for me, but definitely borderline. The length is fine.

I was looking for something to replace the very comfie clogs I wear now but more feminine and lightweight.  These were definitely NOT!  They were very heavy and clunky; the portion around the forefoot cut into my foot so was very uncomfortable.  And I felt that the strap would be uncomfortable the longer I wore it.  I didn't feel I could go up a size as these were my normal size 7; a bigger size would feel even clunkier!  Sorry but cannot recommend these shoes.

had not worn dansko shoes in many yrs but this was such a fun pair price was right, i had to take the chance. i like that there is a strap to hold onto my feet as the one's i wore back in 2001 while a practicing RN would feel like my feet were going to come out.
Love these shoes -- I get a ton of compliments on them and they are so comfortable. I want another pair!

I bought the black and white version of this shoe. I'm short and hate flats but heels are starting to annoy my middle-aged body. These were a great compromise! Good support--like you'd expect in regular Dansko clogs--but with a rubber sole. These are my running around shoes and they are comfy with or without socks. The white toe gets scuffed, especially from my car pedals, but it cleans right off with a textured sponge. I recommend buying a size down--I'm a 40 typically but my foot slipped way too much. The 39 is perfect! Great for busy moms who don't want to look frumpy.
summary: A Practical Shoe That's Also Cute!

reviewText: loved these so much I went and bought the blue floral pair as well. I adore them and they fit and feel like a Dansko should

These shoes are CUTE. I love how they look. They fit well enough. I usually take a size 7, and ordered the 6.5 - 7 and they are a little roomy; but I would not want them any smaller. I bought them to wear for work for the summer because I needed a closed shoe that would look as well with pants, skirts, and capris. They are comfortable enough if I have a day that I spend mostly sitting or walking around an office setting. But on the days that my work demands that I am out and about and walking, they are disappointing. I actually had to stop at my afternoon break to buy bandages at the drug store to put on the backs of my ankles for the blisters that were developing through my nylon knee-hi's.
summary: Good if you don't have a lot of walking to do

reviewText:
When you find the right size Dansko shoes for you, you can count on every pair of Dansko shoes you purchase to fit perfectly.  These red Hawaiian Valerie canvas shoes are so cute and comfortable.  The strap adjusts according to the height of your arch.
Fabulous to wear anywhere and receive compliments in the process.  Loving every step I take in Dansko shoes!
I love my new Danskos! They fit perfectly, are very comfortable, look great with skirts or pants. I have received many compliments on them. They are comfortable with or without socks.
Very comfortable.  The size worked fine.  I bought a different style of Dansko clogs and they were too short at size 8.5-9.
I really love these shoes but they fit a bit tight. Hopefully they will stretch over time and I will be able to wear them more often.

I just received my second pair of shoes. I am older and relish the good support they provide. The shoes are not heavy like so many well supported shoes. I have several pairs of Dansko  I like these the best due to their weight and support. i

If you are familiar with Dansko and do not have a wide foot you may have better success with this shoe. I found it pinched across the top of my foot. Given that it was cotton I thought it would stretch out. It did a little but not enough to keep wearing them.  Also after about 2 months the side of the fabric above the grey stripe started peeling back from the sole.  Now I thought this was because I have hobbit feet (in my opinion) but my partner also bought these shoes and she has thin elf-like feet and hers are doing the same thing.  I would not buy this style again.  Now I know why they were so affordable.
summary: Cute shoe with great arch support

reviewText: I have plantar faciitis and I am on m feet all the time. I got a similar pair for work and figured I could use a pair for everyday wear. My feet love this brand and this style. Well worth the price, well worth the wait ( about 2 days for delivery). Thank You Dansko and Amazon.
have always like dansko shoes but at this point this is my favorite! I ended up ordering another pair in navy so I could wear them more often!

Although the first pair I bought was a little short in the toe box (size 39), the relief to my aching feet was so immediate I cut the straps off and wear them in the house all the time.  I purchased a second pair in size 40 to wear out and about.  The sole structure shifts your weight forward and relieves your heels of pressure, the arch has a nice supportive structure.  Pain free feet for me!
These shoes were comfortable 'right out of the box'.  I have enjoyed them so much and get lots of compliments.  Thank you Dansko!!!
Got these for an upcoming vacation.  Love they way they look, and even though I am just wearing around the house right now, they are super comfortable.  The test will be Vegas!
As soon as I put on these shoes, they felt so comfortable.  I wish they came in more colors!  Love the heel height.  Perfect for casual wear.
These shoes fit great, and I wear them a lot! I get a lot of compliments on them, and I love them. I will probably get more colors! Great spring shoe!
Nice shoe very comfortable color is good  cant wait to wear them with my red scrubs. Will get the blue ones next

I have a D width foot and these are a perfect fit.  The colors are beautiful. My real shoe size is a 9D but because of the width I find I often have to order a 9.5.  I am very pleased with these shoes,
What more can I say? I wore it to work the day after I received it in the mail. It is the perfect summer shoe! Lightweight, yet supportive and summer style!
These are cute and summery but they are 'short' and kind of stiff.....but I find that with a lot of Dansko - like they're 'skimping' on the material.

These shoes are comfortable, true to size. They weigh a ton. I've never worn Dansko's before, hoping these are comfortable for a walking vacation. The vamp comes up a little higher than it appears, (from the front rubber tip of shoe
to the curve at top of foot) I can feel the edge. I'll have to report back.
summary: Really comfortable, they are a little heavy.

reviewText: I've always wanted a pair of Danskos. But price usually stopped me. I've had multiple ankle surgeries so I can't wear cheap shoes. I usually invest once a year in good shoes. These are obnoxiously fun, look cute with skirts, capris or jeans! Not to mention incredibly comfortable. Perfect summer shoe!!
My feet are finally in love!! I have a very hard time with shoes and Danskos are the best for me. I have about 3 pr of Danskos and now I want more of the Mary Jane style.............they're the best!
Fit perfectly and provide great support and fun to my summer outfits.  Highly recommend!  I'm a big Dansko fan, as well.
SO CUTE, FIT ME PERFECT!!! PUT THEM ON AND WALKED ALL DAY!!! GOING TO BUY ANOTHER PAIR!! THEY ARE GREAT!

Like so many other reviewers, I started purchasing dansko shoes because of sore feet. Each pair I have have definitely helped with that. This pair is light airy and comfortable. The only concern I have is that they are a little tight around my toe-tendon area. This seems to be an issue alot of reviewers have. Im going to keep them and hope they loosen up. I also should note that I purchased my regular size and they seem to fit fine everywhere else.
Getting Dansko shoes at a great price is a good thing.  Getting fun summers shoes at a fantastic savings that will look cute with summer clothes is a great thing.
Wonderful product, fast delivery and excellent cost! This is my second pair of dansko shoes and I love them, my feet don't hurt anymore.
I always, always wear a Dansko 41, but these seem a little bigger than normal.  Not sure why.  I actually think the 40 might fit in this style.

I bought 3 of these (the Hawaiian ones in red, blue, and green) and I could not be more happy with these shoes.  The day I pulled them out of the box, I wore them all day and all night long.  Walking through airports, etc., these shoes have not brought me one moment of blisters, rubbing, nor pain and when it's time to pull them off -- I don't want to!  They're that comfortable!!  I hope the Navy ones go on sale soon.  I have lots of Danskos but I'll be reaching for these the most.  OH, and I love the way the elastic on the end of the strap lets me put them on & pull them off without having to unbuckle them!  I LOVE THESE SHOES :)

I love dansko shoes period.  It's the only kind I put on my feet for work, I'm a nurse and your running.  I love them so much I probably have 11pairs for just my days off .  I have shoes for snow to days of sunshine. And it's a plus when I can get a great sale.  Since the price was so great again, I have 3 in this style alone.

Shoes are even cuter in person!  They are true to size and the prize was amazing.  I have gotten tons of compliments on these shoes, and people are so surprised that they are Dansko's.  I just purchase another pair in a different color.
I'm so pleased with my new shoes! I'm especially excited about all the colors I can pair them with! I never thought they would be so versatile!

I wasn't going to get these originally since I didn't know if I was going to wear a printed patterened shoe but I'm glad I did. They are extremely comfortable and anyone who has ever purchased Danskos knows they are wonderful and support your foot. I have had more compliments on how fun my shoes are and where could they get a pair. My answer is always Amazon is where you get the best deals. Once you know what size you are with this brand you can purchase any shoe online and it always fits. That is why I choose Dansko!

I have a couple other pair of Dansko shoes and after wearing them you get spoiled by how they keep your feet and legs from hurting.  When looking at some for summer though I was hoping to save a little money.  I not only saved 2/3's of the price from where I was looking before but I found a pair I liked even more!  These are a little tighter in length than my other pair but still feel great!  I normally wear an 8 in USA size. I have to say the only drawback is that I have been stopped almost everywhere I go when wearing these shoes!  Everyone loves them and wants to know where I bought them!!  Watch out Amazon! and Thanks!!
summary: If you don't like getting stopped and talked to by total strangers don't buy these shoes!

reviewText: This Is Such A Cute Shoe And I Get Plenty Of Compliments. It Is A Heavy Shoe So I Dont Know Yet HoW many hours MY Legs Can Endure. However, They Are Very Comfortable. I Usually Wear An 8 1/2 Shoe ButmMy Foot Is OnTheNarrow Side. I Ordered Two Sizes..One That Was A Little Short(And Because Of The Rubber Toe Would Not Have Any Give), And One That Was A Little Big. I Kept The Larger Size, Added Comfort InSoles, And They Seem To Be Fine..EspeciallY Predicting That  my Feet Will swell A Bit From The SSummer Heat. I Wear These Without Socks.

This shoe fit perfectly and I bought it for work where I am on my feet 6-7 hours a day and running.  I wore it the first day for 6 hours and it still felt great.  I highly recommend this shoe and other Dansko products.

I absolutely LOVE these shoes.  They fit like a clog, perfect.  So comfy, even w/ no socks.  I got numerous compliments on them and hope to order another pair before they're gone.  I can see how they might not fit well if you had problems w/ feet swelling.
I teach, and Dansko shoes are comfortable and offer great support - all day long.  The fun colors and designs look as great as they feel!
summary: If you have to stand all day, you may as well do it in a pair of Dansko!

reviewText: These shoes are really cute for the summer and they are extremely comfortable.  As with all Danskos, if you have a wider foot, it usually helps to go up a size which I did and they fit perfectly.
Valeries are sneaker  like, comfortable, and a little dressier. These are perfect  for with black shorts or capris. They have quickly become an essential wardrobe item.
I have several Dansko shoes.  Some are very comfortable, others not so comfortable.  This shoe fits fine, I love the print, the style is comfortable and goes well with pants and skirts.

These are very cute, but unfortunately too narrow and rather heavy. I'd heard great things about Dansko so it was disappointing to have to send them back. Tried the non-canvas version too, but ran into the same problem.

I have worn these shoes and still they are in great shape.  I wear them everywhere.  I can wash them in the washing machine and let them air dry and I can wear them the next day.  They are durable and comfortable.

These are the most comfortable shoes.  They are so cute and feel sooo good.  Thank you, Dansko!
I hope to purchase another pair asap.

I've been a florist for the past 18 years, so I've logged a lot of time on my feet.  I wear professional Dansko clogs for work, so I was thrilled to be able to find styles for everyday wear.  I can be on my feet all day in these without a problem.  My feet thank me every time I put them on.

It was not as I expected in the height of the sole and the stiffness.  It is good for my arches but somewhat heavy and clumsy.  For me, after so long my knee starts hurting which is not ever the case.

I have two young children, so no matter where I go, I am usually on the run.
These look nice, feel great, and I can run in them!
I LOVE them!
They are a bit heavy, but they give you a lot of stability and traction!
summary: I now have a high heel sneaker!

reviewText: fit great; very comfortable especially since i have foot problems; love the colors, exactly as expected; highly recommend to others

I haven't worn Danskos in years. The clearance price was what first caught my eye, and I am certainly glad it did. These shoes fit true to size. They were comfortable right of the box, and really cute.

I thought these Danskos would be great for teaching summer school, since they're canvas and almost a sandal.  I forgot that I can't wear mary jane shoes because they always rub where I have a little bone spur and a sensitive scar from surgery, so I gave them to my cousin who loves them.  Lucky her...
summary: Cute shoe, if only I could wear it...

reviewText: Extremely affordable price for Dansko shoes which are an excellent make in the shoe industry.  Each shoe was individually wrapped in plastic making the presentation impressive. I am very happy with my purchase.

If you love Dansko shoes, you'll love these too! Great fit, comfortable and they're so fun!  I discovered Dansko's several years ago due to a back injury and now they are my go to shoes for pain free days. They will be great for summer and with jeans as well.
Shoe are cute, but really heavy and toe is not deep enough, after short time it was cutting into to of  my foot.

I was hesitant buying shoes without trying them on but took a chance on these since I already have a couple of pairs of Dankos.  They are the most comfortable shoes ever! I have had several foot surgeries and haven't been comfortable in shoes for alon time. Love my Valerie's! I'm going to get another pair.
I ended up having to return the 39's for 38's.  The 38's are a perfect fit for my 8-1/2 narrow foot!

Love Dansko clogs and was delighted to see a summer fabric and style.  They are very comfortable and fit true to size.  The mary jane style is really cute and I think I'll be wearing these a lot this summer.  May get another color!  Recommend them as an alternative shoe for walking or being on your feet all day when you need something a bit more stylish than a tennis shoe.

What a perfect shoe at a great price.  It's everything you expect from a Dansko in the way of comfort but in a toned down version made of canvas.  It's stylish in the prints and with the Maryjane strap, giving it's casual fell a little bit of flair, but it's every bit as kind to your feet as any Dansko.  I have Morton's Neuroma, which causes pain in the ball of my foot when inflamed.  I bought this to wear during a terrible flair up and it was a blessing.  It's roomy like it's counterpart but seems even more cushioned.  I just love it.

These Dansko's fit true to size as all the other Dansko shoes I've purchased.  However, the canvas rim at the base of my toes is a bit tight and stiff.  I'm going to try to stretch it out and will hopefully be ok.  The color and pattern of the shoe is great, and the price well worth it.  I expect to wear these spring and summer!  UPDATE: I did stretch out the canvas rim by balling up some socks and leaving in place for several days.  Made a huge difference, and now the shoes are very comfortable.  Wore them out one evening and every woman I spoke to commented on how cute the shoes were, and where could they get a pair!
summary: Dansko Valerie Mary-Jane's in red Hawaiian

reviewText: I'm a big fan of Dansko Women's shoes...They are not only attractive in style, but are true to size.  They are comfortable, and when I have to walk for long periods of time I know my feet and legs will not bark when I take them off.  I purchased two pair and I am quite happy with both pair.

As other reviewers posted, these shoes aren't as wide as other Dansko shoes, but they're still wider than regular shoes. I have an average foot and it fits great! No rubbing (I don't wear socks with these) and I think they're cute and a bit funky. They work great with jeans!

I usually wear Skechers in the spring/summer at work with capris/clamdigger lenth pants.  I also wear custom-made orthotics with almost all shoes due to really bad flat feet (pes planus).  And I work as an outpatient PT in a busy clinic.  I recently discovered Danskos and cannot go back to regular shoes!  (At least for work.).  Although this line of Danskos are not AS supportive as their PROFESSIONAL line (i.e. not as high arch support and not as stiff), they are still far superior than Skechers.  I can wear them for a 10-hour day and my feet are not sore or tired.

My job requires me to be on my feet the whole time so I need good shoes for support.  I always get Dansko's because they have great arch support and they last a long time.  These canvas ones are great for spring and summer.  I have the tan pair as well and wear them constantly

I broke my foot over a year ago so now I need to wear shoes with a good arch support.  Dansko has the best arch that I have found and this shoe met all my expectations!  Was wanting a fun shoe for summer so after reading other reviews ordered this Valerie canvas a size larger.  My favorite shoe has been Dansko's black canvas Veda.  Just recently purchased Dansko's Sophie Swirl Leather Coffee sandals.  Beautiful!  Will definitely look at Dansko whenever I am purchasing shoes!

These are a cute little number to wear spring through early fall.  Because I will use talc and go sockless, I ordered down in size (as they run fairly true to the other Danskos).  If you are a "true" size in Danskos (if a 38 fits perfectly and you wear thin socks), I would order the same size in this model.  I find that a 38 Dansko Professional is a tad loose on me but a 37 is too short to allow the back to move loosely as it should in a clog.  I am forced to wear a thicker stocking for fit and go with the 38.  Sockless, the 37 is a fit, for me.  These are the first Danskos I have ordered to allow for summer wear and I'm delighted with them!

After reading the reviews I was a bit scared when after trying my new Valeries for the first time they did feel a bit tight and even hurt around my instep. But I am happy to report the inconvenience lasted only the first two days. Since then, I wear them without a single problem. And they do look great!
summary: It took a bit but finally it worked!

reviewText: The print on the shoe is VERY bright and the shoes were a bit snug.  And the heels are super high making them look like hipster nursing shoes.  I really wanted to like them, but sadly they are being returned.

First dansko purchase to test out all the nurses' reviews.

Dansko is indeed very comfortable. I have bad posture so the slightly heavy shoes help keep me grounded and walk straight.

I got the Hawaiian Red, goes well with my red rain jacket :)
First pair of clogs, still getting used to the look but I am digging it now. And best part is? Vegan shoes that is so comfortable!!!! WIN!

Got these shoes because I have the Dansko boots, which are super comfortable.  These did not disappoint!  They are very comfortable, and will go great with shorts, skirts and jeans this summer!!  And, the price could not be beat!
I really liked these shoes. They fit well, are very comfortable, and make me feel a nice spring in my step!

These shoes look great...just the look to go with pants and casual dresses while on my trip to Europe.  Unfortunately, they are wayyyy TOO heavy for walking in all day as I will be while sight seeing. The rubber soles are very heavy.  Danko, please make these with lighter soles.  had to return them.

I gave this four stars because it is a little tight across the toe.  I read another review that agrees with that statemetn and they have suggested a shoe horn to strech the top out a little.  I do not have a super wide foot or super narrow.. just a normal foot so expect it to be a little tight across the top in the canvas brand. now onto the comfort level.. WOW... this is my first pair of Dansko's and I cannot WAIT to try more!  They are so comfortable.  The support is amazing and I love that the sole is Vegan.  I've ordered a shoe horn and cannot wait to wear these after stretching!!
summary: Comfort for your feet.. but a little tight

reviewText: The fit is somewhat loose and the sole thick and stiff.  I feel like I am wearing clogs rather than sneakers meaning, I am kicking when I walk rather than rolling through my feet. The only complaint I have is that the stiff canvas cuts a bit into the top of my foot.  I am hoping these will soften up after a few times.  I have really wide feet but these look great on my feet.  The red version is super perky and looks great with cropped pants.  And for the price, these are great weekend kick around kind of shoes.

I saw these dansko shoes on sale for roughly thirty dollars and jumped at the chance for a pair.  When they arrived they fit comfortably but were quite a bit more narrow than my clog style danskos.  I'm glad I already order a size up!  Otherwise they are a great shoe and several of my friends have purchased the same shoes.

First off, they are cute, but a bit bulkier than I'm used to. This is my first time trying Danskos. I ordered a 39 because other reviews said to size up. I normally wear an 8. Sometimes I have to size down to a 7.5, whereas other, less frequent times- with dress shoes, I have to size up to an 8.5. My feet are "normal" width. When I put them on and walked in them, my heels slid out of the shoes. I could fit three full fingers behind my heel so I had to send 'em back. I reordered these in a 38 and I'm hoping for the best. According to other reviews, these Danskos fit differently than other Danskos even, so I recommend either going to a shoe store that has these exact shoes in stock and trying them on in-person or ordering two sizes and returning the one that doesn't fit so you don't have to wait a month between ordering and finally getting the size that actually fits. Good luck! I'll follow-up with a new review once I get the 38's.
summary: Cute but I shouldn't have sized up.

reviewText: These are wonderful shoes! I am a Dansko fan because I have high arches and Dansko never lets me down - they are so comfortable. Dansko is making more and more cute shoes, too! even ladies at the office who would not be caught dead in "comfortable shoes" are complimenting these. :)
I haven't had a chance to wear these yet as it is still snowing and too cold. I tried them on, wore them around the house, and, as usual, they are perfect.
I was surprised at the reasonable price for a Dansko shoe.  It is a nice shoe.  Fun and my feet feel so nice after a long day in them.
love it and get many compliments.  fits like my other danskos.  possibly went a size smaller.  sometimes i'm a 38 and sometimes a 39

I love the shoes but found the sizing a bit tricky. I went to a local retailer to try on a pair of leather Danskos before I ordered. This helped somehat but I'm guessing I could have worn a smaller size. I am already looking forward to my next pair.

I have a problem with my aquiles tendon and have to wear very confortable shoes while at work. I work at a hospital and do quite a bit of walking and standing.
perfect for the summer .

I need shoes for summer with toes for my job and that I can walk distances in and these fill the bill in every way.  I have owned Danskos before and was so happy to see something so summery.  They didn't disappoint and I may just order another pair in another color!!
I love these shoes.  This is my second pair.  I wore the last pair out.  I highly recommend this shoe.

This is my 3rd pair of canvas clogs, but these flowered clogs are gorgeous, and I am getting compliments.  They are very easy to wear, look great with jeans, are good walking shoes, and I love them!  And, they will not be my last pair.
Love them.  Comfy, fun, good for puddles.  People see them and smile and ask where they came from.  Great shoes.  :)

I recently bought some Dansko shoes because my doctor recommended them for my feet and back. I loved the others I bought and these were such a great deal  so thought I could by these on line. It didn't work.

The shoes came quickly just as the vendor said - no problem there. and I returned them free of charge with no problem at all - so it was well worth the risk to purchase shoes on line.

The color looked more red in the photo above. They were actually kind of orangie pink in color and a bit faded in the design. They looked more clunky than cute when I got them. But the biggest thing that didn't work was the tightness across the bridge of my foot - it was really tight and uncomfortable.

I could have ordered a larger size which would fit me better, but because of the color and the design across the top of  my foot, I knew I wouldn't like them and they wouldn't be comfortable at any size.

Maybe they will work for someone else - just not me.
Fit perfect. Just as I expected from Dansko. The price was super! A better deal than my local shoe store.
This shoe is super comfortable and cute.  I love it so much that I am also going to order it in black.
On days my feet swell more, I can't wear these shoes long. Love the colors. I need to learn how to clean the white part though
These shoes are so cute and so comfortable.  They also have a pink pair I would like to have.  Very fun!

Really comfortable and great for everyday stuff.  It also cleans easily if it gets scuffed or muddy.

I only give a 5 star if the product knocks my socks off.  I love these.  They get the job done.  Four stars is pretty great for me.
summary: Great shoe... just what I needed

reviewText: These are Dansko shoes, just made in canvas.  They are very comfortable just like my other Danskos.  They are a little bright in color, but I still love them and would buy them again.

I ordered a pair of these when Amazon had the orange color they were clearing out, so they were deeply discounted.  I ordered a 39 which is the same as I wear in other Dansko shoes.  In other brands I'm more like an 8-8.5

These shoes are totally cute, and they match a surprising number of things given that they are orange!  I wear them with jeans and skirts, and they look nice with both.  They are also very comfortable when I'm wearing them, and have become my go-to leave by the door shoe to throw on if I'm going out to run errands.  I also like that I can wear them with or without socks and they still feel good on my feet.  I gave them 4 stars instead of 5 because I wish they had more arch support.  The arch support is one of the things I like about Dansko shoes, but these are not as supportive as my other pairs.  When I do a lot of walking in these, my feet hurt the next day due to the lack of arch support.  I still wear them often, but if I'm going to be walking I pick a different pair to wear.  I do have very high arches, but that's one of the reasons I normally like Dansko.

I considered ordering a pair of these in black to use as "commuting" shoes, but ultimately decided to look for a pair with better arch support.  The reason I considered these is because the platform is raised without being a heel, which provides enough of a boost to keep my work pants (which have been tailored for heels) from dragging on the ground.
Love these shoes!! Super comfy, well built and a bargain price. i might get another pair in a different color and I NEVER do that!
Only my 2nd pair of Danskos and I'm in love!  It's hard to find comfortable *and* cute shoes.  These are both!

They are cute, colorful, well-made, and affordable. Typical Dansko footbed design, but with different materials. I don't notice any difference in comfort, though, which makes them a great casual shoe.
This is a great Danko shoe.  I had paid over $100 for the same shoe in blue in a local store here in Anchorage, so I was thrilled to get another pair so cheap.
summary: A great price for a great shoe!

reviewText: Looks cute in picture, but the color and shape is down right ugly. Its heavy too. I would not recommend this to anyone.
They work great with my orthotics!  The buckle strap keeps everything in place perfectly.  The colors will be perfect with summer clothing.
summary: These are great shoes to wear with orthotics!

reviewText: I love the look and oh so comfy!  I wish they came in purple!  I also love the green!  Thank you
I like the shoe, but heel rubs and causes blister until you get used to it. But is nice shoe
Super comfy, I wore them 12 hours the first day!  Not to mention cute! :) Would definitely recommend these shoes to anyone who has to be on their feet for hours!
I think I will forever only own Dansko shoes.  I am 65 years old and my feet have hurt all my life, until my little sister told me about Dansko.  I love these shoes.

Wore this once and got lots of comments.  The print draws eyes down to the feet and people noticed.  The shoes were very comfortable with the first wearing.  Don't expect any problems and will give this 5 stars if they are still comfortable and hold up well after several more wearings!

I ordered my regular european size of 36. I normally wear a size 6 american. These fit me perfect. Plenty of toe room and didn't bother my bunion on my right foot. I stand on my feet all day at my job and I gave them the test this last Friday. At six o'clock p.m. my feet were not hurting! I say they passed with flying colors! :)

I am a 'true' size 10 and the size 41 fit me perfectly. Clogs are supposed to be a bit big so don't be surprised if there's room to spare, the top strap will keep them in place. I got the Hawaiian Red color, which it a neon coral with shades of mauve. They are super cute and the price is AMAZING, but how often can you wear that color? For me not often so I went to a local craft shop and got a small bottle of Tulip Soft Fabric Paint like this Tulip 29377 Soft Neutral Fabric Paint, 5-Pack The one bottle was less than two dollars. I chose Night Sky which is a very dark grey (or soft black) with sparkles in it. My seven year old daughter and I painted them this morning and they look fabulous. I'll post a picture so you can see how cute they are.

I will admit I have a tall vamp, and as other reviewers stated, this is just too tight across the top. The shoe is super cute, and I was bummed to have to return it. My feet are already a size 42, so there was no sizing up for me.
summary: Super cute but too tight across the vamp

reviewText: I wasn't sure I would like them, but they are cute. Size is good. I wear 81/2 and the 39 was perfect. They are sneaker like and comfortable. The price was right!!! Can't go wrong...good deal for a good shoe.

Just got these today.  I have always liked Dansko shoes, and these are no exception.  They are great for spring and summer.  Obviously well-made with superior materials.  They were on sale, which makes me appreciate them even more.

I ordered these shoes to take on a European trip this summer as we will be doing lots of walking.  So far, I love them!  They are very comfy, true to size, and I can slip my orthotics in with no problem.  Liked the price, too, as they are a bit more reasonable than other Dansko shoes I looked at.  They look very smart with my ankle and capri pants!

I already had a pair of these shoes in black that I payed full price for and I really liked them. the toe box is roomy.
I usually wear a 9 and the 39 was a good fit. So when I saw I could order the print shoes at such a great deal I was quick to do so. They could be considered a little heavy by some , but I like  everything about them. I usually wear them at work where I am on my feet for 4-5 hours at a stretch and find them very comfortable. I would definately  recommend them to others.

This is a pretty alternative to a sneaker. A bit dressier you can wear this comfortable
shoe with a dress or slacks. It is not a soft shoe, it has a firm base and rubber soul.
I have an aching lower back and these shoes give great support and balance much more
than a sneaker. Without sacrificing style, this is a very good substitute.

I work in a bakery and it is an on your feet all day job.  'couldn't be happier with these shoes!  They were comfy right out of the box and look cute with capri's for the hot summer months!  Only down side for me is a little harder to clean mine will end up multi colored anyway!
Was looking for a more pliable shoe.  This one is heavy and it cut across my toes in an uncomfortable place.  Pretty tho!
I liked the look of this shoe, but it did not fit my wide feet. I had to return them.
Ladies of all ages have noticed these sweeties and have asked where I got them.... I really like them, although you have to break them in. I suggest wearing socks with them, thin dress socks.
summary: I get a lot of compliments!

reviewText: As a teacher, I need comfortable shoes to be able survive being on my feet all day.  I already own two pair of the traditional leather clog Danskos that I've worn for years, but come summertime, they tend to be pretty hot (and not exactly the best fashion statement with capris or shorter skirts).  I didn't know if I'd be able to find anything that met my "comfortable and cool" criteria - but then I found these.  Not only were they more affordable on Amazon than ever buying them in a discount store, but they are SO comfortable, cute, and the canvas lets them breathe!  I can't wait to rock these cute, funky teacher shoes as the weather starts to warm up!
The shoes look nice as expected but a little disappointed because they are heavy. Not wearing yet so don't know how comfortable they are.
These shoes fit perfectly, and keep me able and willing to stand and move around all day long. I wish they came in yellow!

This was not the case they were smaller than the other Danskos that I own. On my first day wearing these I had to leave work after 2 hours to get another pair of shoes, because my heels were bleeding. I was finally able to get them worn in so that my heels didn't bleed but only after buying Dr. Scholls heel guards. I was disappointed because I have had luck with other Danskos. This experience definitely proved to me that buying shoes online is a bad idea.

I have been a Dansko fan for over a decade, and must have owned a dozen pair over the years.  I bought these because I'm pregnant and I wanted a cute summer shoe that would still give me the support I need.  I was really excited to get them.  They are definitely as cute as pictured, but I have to say they are the least comfortable Danskos I have owned.  The canvas rubs my feet, and my feet get really sweaty in them.  I thought being canvas they would breathe enough to wear barefoot, but that's not the case.  I have to wear little hide-a-socks, otherwise my feet will get very stinky (and I don't get stinky feet in any other shoes).  They also provide the least arch support of any Dansko I've worn, which is probably the biggest disappointment.  I decided to keep them, because they're just so darn cute and I'm short on summer shoes at this point, but for the price I'm a little bummed.

Wow!
These shoes are fabulous.  I'm not a shoe hog by any means (I own a pair of hiking boots, sandals, good tennis shoes and a pair of pumps) and I finally broke down and admitted I needed some nicer looking shoes for work.  I work in a medical clinic, so they needed to be comfortable, closed toe, and look nice.  I did an initial search for "nurse" shoes and these came up.

I'm picky about my shoes for a variety of reasons.  I have a lot of problems with arch supports because I have Plantar Fasciitis, and my left leg has problems with my Achilles tendon.  Between that, low ankles (shoes that are tall, without going over the ankle, tend to rub blisters just below my ankles) and narrow heels, it's very difficult to find shoes that fit my feet and I don't wind up limping in.

I timidly bought these on impulse, immediately regretted it and brooded over them until they arrived last night.

I CANNOT BE HAPPIER WITH A SHOE!

Fabulous arch support, the back is narrow enough to hold my heel and wide enough for my toes at the front, the soles are really thick and cushiony, and the maryjane strap holds the shoe exactly where it needs to be.  I wore them to work today, and have been on cloud nine!  Seriously, there isn't a shoe I wear that does NOT hurt me somehow.. and these don't hurt my feet at all.  It's as if they were made for my feet!  I've been on my feet all day in clinic, walked 8 blocks at lunch, and it's the first time in years everything feels fine.  No foot pain, no achilles tendon pain, no blisters under my ankles or on my heels!

Plus, I've been getting compliments all day about how amazingly cute these shoes are!

I'm going to tell everyone I know about these shoes, and buy more in the future.  You have a customer for life, Dansko, after only one day of wearing.  Thank you for these shoes!
summary: Timidly bought, but amazingly wow'ed by these shoes

About 40% of the leg portion is a tight-woven fabric not covered by leather, and of this portion, in the front ONLY, the 1/4"-thick foam inner liner thins out in a vertical seam about 3/8" wide and fairly thin, so this MIGHT be a weak spot in the protection (but I doubt it). reviewText:
My son is a huge superhero fan and I thought he'd love this item.  He saw it in the box and couldn't wait for me to open it.  I got it open, adjusted the head straps and put it on him, and he ran into the bathroom to look in the mirror.  He came back into the kitchen, took it off, and never picked it up again.  There were definitely good things about the toy.

1. It is a very heavyweight plastic and feelsl ike it would be great quality.  It is a bit heavy though.
2. The eye openings are large so kids can see well out of them.  This would be a great mask for a Halloween costume.
3. The head strap is "T" shaped and adjustable so it fits nice and snug.
4. There are forehead and nose pieces to hold the mask in place firmly when in use.
5. The eyes light up and the voice recording is very clear and not muffled.

My biggest complaint was that for the price, it really doesn't do much.  You push a button, eyes light up, and a Spiderman phrase is spoken.  I can see it getting really boring really fast.

Awesome!  Cool!  These are the words that my soon to be 6 year old son exclaimed as he checked out and played with the Spider Man Spidey Sense Mask.  Needless to say he is loving it!!!  As soon as the box came this morning, he ripped into it and together we released Spidey from his box (not too difficult compared to the way some of the toys are packaged these days).

The color of the mask is vibrant and very appealing.  Personally I love the material it is made from.  Is it plastic?  Yes.  However it is not the hard type of plastic that so many masks are made with.  This is sort of like a soft/rubberized type of plastic that is slightly flexible and more comfortable.  To me, I think this will make the toy much more resistant to breaking and cracking.  The web design is a rubber material and just feels cool.  I can see this holding up to some rough and tumble play.  Another aspect that I was surprised by was the way the mask attached to the head.  Instead of a rubber band type of attachment, there is a T-crossing set of straps - designed much like that of a ball cap adjuster.  This allows for the child to be able to fit it so that it is comfortable both around the head and the forehead area.  My son even commented how this was just like his baseball cap.  These straps are also a soft and flexible rubberized type of plastic.

Now for the fun stuff - the talking and lighting up!  As stated, the mask says 10 different phrases (compliments of a square button on the upper right portion of the mask.  Surprisingly the phrases are spoken very clear and easy to understand, rather than garbled and distorted.  The volume is not overly loud, though could probably get on nerves is pushed repeatedly, lol.  When the button is pushed, there are two small lights on each of the Spidey eyes that make the yellow portion of the eyes light up.  This is pretty cool - though will not be noticeable in a lighted area.  My son took the mask in the bathroom where there are no windows and it is dark to try this part out.  His reaction?  "COOL!!!!"  I have to admit it does look pretty cool.

I also want to mention that the mask does get warm - yes, I even tried it on for myself, lol - though I love the fact that there are air slits across the entire bottom portion of the mask to allow for plenty of air and breathing circulation.

Overall this mask is a HUGE hit at our house.  I highly recommend it for any Spidey fan and am very confident that it will hold up well.  The design is very well made and I applaud the company for that - rather than making some cheezy cheap mask that the kids go crazy for that will only break and/or crack within a few days of play.  The price of $20 is an excellent one, I think and you will definitely get your money's worth through your child's excitement and love of the toy!

reviewText:
My five year old son was so overwhelmed when he first saw this he wouldn't even try it on.  After his excitement level calmed down, we adjusted it for his head size.  That was pretty easy on only took a few minutes.  With a little practice he was able to get it on and off himself (the nose has to fit on just so).  He's had a great time being "Spider Man."

There is a little button on the side that plays back a few canned Spider Man sentences.  That part is a little annoying, but my son seemed to get bored with that part pretty quickly.  The mask is really well made and I expect it will last a while.  I think this is going to be a great pretend-play toy for him over the long term.  He certainly seems to be enjoying it now.

Kids love this because it makes them feel/look like Spiderman of course. I would prefer a cloth cover on the back so the back of the head wasn't exposed for more realism, but kids don't seem to mind. With Halloween coming up, this mask is likely going to be a big hit. As this mask has big eyes that kids can easily see through, this mask seems to give a better (safer) field of view for night time trick-or-treaters. Further, the mask allows for air to get in the front without building up too much heat. The voice from the mask is clear and the volume is just right. Kids like to act out the phrases -- it's fun to watch them invent body gestures as the mask talks. The mask seems very durable and will likely withstand a few drops and tumbles. Adults may have to help adjust he mask initially, but many kids will be able to figure it out. Made in China, but that is to be expected.

This mask was an instant hit, with everyone in the family wanting to take a turn wearing it. Fortunately, it's adjustable, and so it fits both adults and children.

With the press of a button, the eyes glow and Spiderman says one of 10 different phrases. The voice is clear and it really does sound the way Spiderman should... a little tough, with a little attitude, but overall pretty wholesome.

The mask is plastic and rubber and it soon feels hot and heavy to the wearer. It also has limited visibility. It's not the kind of thing a child's going to put up with for more than a few minutes and it definitely wouldn't make a good choice for a Halloween costume. That being said, it's great for play sessions and, when it's not being used, it looks really good hanging on the wall!

If there's a Spiderman fan in your life, you can't go wrong with this mask... unless he or she already has one... in which case, keep it for yourself. You'll be glad you did.

;)

reviewText:
My daughter is a big Spider Man fan. For over a year she has had, and regularly dresses up in, a typical fabric Spider Man costume and runs around the house fighting crime.  I thought that this "Spidey Sense Mask" might make her playtime even more fun.  And it did, with a few limitations.  My four and a half year old is pretty small for her age, and this mask was not only too big for her but also very heavy.  When she first put it on, she sort of wobbled around a bit until she got herself used to the weight of it.  The plus side to that is that it's clearly a very sturdy product.  And once she got used to it, as opposed to the thin fabric mask that came with her costume, she was fine.

The biggest draw, for her at least, was the light-up eyes.  A great deal of her initial playtime took place in front of a mirror so that she could see the effect.  The various phrases were fun for her, at first, but she seemed to like to use her own voice to fight crime instead of pre-recorded narration. I also think she got slightly annoyed with having to active the button on the side of the mask anytime she wanted it to light up.  But all of this aside, she had a great deal of fun with this toy and returns to it from time to time.  Recommended.
summary: A bit big and heavy, but solid fun

My son is not fond of the fact that it talks, or even lights up, if you push the button while he is playing with it he gets upset. He would much rather make his own sayings. The band that allows this to actually be a functional mask is strange, unlike most masks that have some sort of elastic or velcro set up this is a flexible plastic with notches and holes, a set up like an older style baseball cap. The firmer band makes the weight of the mask easier to disperse but it also is harder adjust on the fly to fit different kids. Unless your kid is super into noisy toys that spit random catch phrases I would skip this and just get a regular mask.

reviewText:
I gave this to my nephews - 7 & 11 - to play with, and it was a hit, but more for the younger child.  How much fun the toy is truly depends on how big of a Spiderman fan a child is, and how they typically like to spend their time playing.

It did not feel at all flimsy and seemed well-constructed.  I simply don't know how it would stand up over time since this sort of hard plastic can crack/break when dropped, etc.

He does not get questioned or teased about wearing a necklace, and his oral sensory demands are satisfied. Having a chewy on a lanyard instead of loose, means not only it is with my son when he needs it, but it doesn't get set down on his school desk and residual saliva is wiped on his shirt rather than all over his school papers - a relief for his teacher AND his classmates!

The dog tags are just the right size, not thin to be chewed through, but not too thick that its too much for his mouth. Texture is mild, which my son prefers.

The only negative is although the magnet closure is strong, my son ends up playing with it (sticking it to his desk, etc.) and once it was pulled off without notice - thankfully he noticed it when it fell and did not get lost.

The only way to improve these would to remove the company product informational text and replace it with positive affirmation, phrases or words.

Excellent running shoe which I bought myself for my birthday some ~2 years ago. They have maintained their structure as the build quality is excellent. I have used these for running, hiking and various indoor sports and they have served me well.

The shoes provide a mostly comfortable fit for the toes and good enough arch and heel support, the lost star was for the tightness around the widest part of my feet for which loosening the lacings did not seem to help much. However after running for a half hour or so I often can easily ignore the squeeze.

The colour is no longer such a solid white after many hours of trekking through mud and rain, but that only serves to show the quality of these sneakers.

I would say that these shoes are of a reasonable quality for what I paid in that they are still functional after several months of heavy everyday use. However, they did develop some small tears and the soles started to peel off about a week after I purchased them with almost no prompting. These issues are almost entirely aesthetic and haven't progressed much since they initially appeared, but are still somewhat bothersome. They are fairly comfortable, do well in a variety of terrains (including snow), and fit well. On a whole, I would certainly recommend them as a fairly cheap pair of running shoes.
